backblasts.title: 2 Q or not 2 Q?
backblasts.body:
A good brother signs you up for future Qs rather you want them or not. You can always ask someone elese to Q for you if needed, but it's really up to you to step up. 2Q or not 2Q is the question. In the end it's always very rewarding.
The THING:
Brief warm up with Weed Pickers of course. Then we too to the hill for Polo Position Bear Crawls up, 2 Mike Tysons, Crawl Bears down, repeat until every pax has the pole.
CIRCUIT:
On the basketball courts we did Suicide Bernies followed by 20 Merkins + 5 Hand-Rlease Merkins.
Move to the field where we executed Zig Zag runs with 3 Burpees at each bucket.
Move to playground where we executed 10 PullUps, 30 Squats, 20 Lunges
Move to pavilion where we executed 45 varied LBCs, 15 Heel Touches, 15 Freddy mercuries, 10 BBS.
REPEAT CIRCUIT until completly covered in sweat, grass clippings, and pollen.
Following Catbox tradition we played Speedball just hard enough to knock the breath out of Rugburn. No serious injuries were incurred thank God.
Welcomed 2 new outstanding FNGs. SNOWMAN and his 2.0 BAMBINO.
COT: Prayers for strength, guidence, and discipline. Much love!

backblasts.title: IRON SHARPENS IRON
backblasts.body:
*Warm-O-Rama*
Started with a mosey to the other side of the church lot before getting to business:

•	Merkins x5 IC

•	Mountain Climbers x5 IC

•	Shoulder Taps x5 IC

•	Karaoke to the hydrant & back (right side, then left)

•	High Knees to the hydrant & back

•	Bernie Sanders to the hydrant, sprint back
Warmup was over… but not officially until Wax-On got his one SSH later. You’re welcome.
⸻
*The Thang: Partner Grinder*
This was all about teamwork and arm destruction. One PAX worked, the other moved. No rest, no excuses. Rotate when the moving partner returned.
Round 1

•	P1: Merkins (AMRAP)

•	P2: Karaoke to the hydrant & back

•	Switch & Repeat
Wax-on got his one SSH!
Round 2 (10 min)

•	P1: Mountain Climbers (AMRAP)

•	P2: High Knees to the hydrant & back

•	Switch & Repeat
Mid-round shoulder burn bonus:

•	Sun Gods x10 IC (forwards & backwards)

•	Michael Phelps OYO
Round 3 (10 min)

•	P1: Shoulder Taps (AMRAP)

•	P2: Bernie Sanders to the hydrant, run back

•	Switch & Repeat
After finishing, ran back to the flag for a little extra Mary & punishment.
⸻
Mary & Finishing Touches

•	Hustler: American Hammers

•	Wax-On: LBCs

•	YHC: Super Slow Merkins x10 IC (holding plank at the top for max pain)

•	Finisher: Last Minute consecutively High Knees → Butt Kicks → High Knees → 3 Merkins to close it out
⸻
COT
YHC shared thoughts on teamwork—one of the first things I remember from my own first F3 workout. Also admitted that I couldn’t do a proper push-up when I started, which is why today was an arm-smashing beatdown.
“The strength of the team is each individual member. The strength of each member is the team.” — Phil Jackson
A true leader isn’t just out front barking orders—he’s in the trenches, pushing his brothers, lifting them when they fall, and expecting the same in return. Iron sharpens iron.
Announcements & Prayer Requests
Requests were lifted, prayers were said, and coffee was earned.
Moleskin:

•	Arms are toast.

•	Wax-On got his one SSH.

•	Teamwork wins every time.

•	Iron sharpens iron.
Now, go do something hard today.

SYITG, Copper

today was a whole shebang. THE THANG: An array of compound exercises to help maintain functional fitness, which allows us to be able to do whatever we want or need to as the need arises. A series of 8 exercises, with coupon, with a run down the BB court and back in between each exercise. 1. Squat to overhead press X 20 2. Plank with coupon pull through x 15 (DC) 3. Curls X 30 4. Merkens x 20 5. Big Boy SU’s – X 10 w coupon or X 20 w/o 6. 1 arm pull x 20 or bent over row x 20 7. Burpee x 15 8. Face press x 30 After 1st round completed, Lunges down the court, Bernie’s back. Repeat the sequence. After 2nd round completed, run the perimeter of the court w coupon. Repeat the sequence. Diminish each exercise in the 3rd round by 5.

backblasts.title: PB Anniversary Q - Intentionality About Having No Plan
backblasts.body:
WARMUP: Mixed standard and running warmo. Epic fail on Zombie Crawls – the blacktop at the Den is too grippy!

THE THANG: YHC was intentional about having no plan, as he wanted to lead an old school, off the cuff BD for his 6th anniversary.

Thang 1: 3 rounds of 6 curb to curb sprints, with short rest in between.

Thang 2: Burpback Mountain. Mosey to bottom of FMS hill and Partner up for 100 collective burpees. One partner does burpees, one partner runs up and down hill three times (backward up and forward down). Flapjack until all burpees completed. Much grumbling occurred when YHC said "100 burpees." Then almost immediately the mumblechatter relented to windedness.

Thang 3: 6 rounds of Jackass Burpee Webb escalator. Start with 1 burpee and 2 donkey kicks. Do 5 more rounds all the way to 6 burpees and 12 donkey kicks. Many a PAX looked as if they were about to spew merlot – YHC included.

Thang 4: Cocaine Bear. Bear crawl one bus lot space, do 5 merkins in cadence. Repeato 5 more times for total of 6 bus lanes – attempt to hold bear crawl/plank position entire time. Mucho chatter about 'powder' and dudes not getting their noses close enough to the pavement. Much grumbling about there being 13 minutes left on the clock.

Thang 5: Mini Dora. Wax on frustrated at the audacity of YHC calling for a 30 second recovery period. Oh well – you can't please everybody! Partner up again for two rounds of Dora. One partner runs to end of bus lanes and back, other partner performs exercise and then flapjack. Exercises were 50 BBS and 50 Mike Tysons

Thang 6: Finisher. 60 second wall sit followed by 4 curb to curb springs. 30 second balls to the wall followed by 4 curb to curb sprints. 60 second plank followed by 50 Rocky Balboas.

MARY: Gazelles did Mary throughout

ANNOUNCEMENTS: Postponement of Catbox Third F breakfast

COT:Stays in the COT

NAKED MAN: YHC is thankful to those who came out for his anniversary Q and for The Den in general. Sometimes the impromptu beatdowns are the worst!

F3 Dodgeball, counted off into 1's and 2's, then within those groups, teams paired up.

Bench Press

Curls

Goblet Squats

Overhead Press

Dodgeball:

Standard International Dodgeball rules

backblasts.title: How many manmakers?
backblasts.body:
We did some warmup execises and they were a bummer.  The Q made everyone listen to Feliz Navidad and do a burpee everytime he said the title of the song.  The song is the audio equivalent of coal in the BD stocking, so it was also terrible. But then someone had the bright idea of having 25 manmakers at one of the stations.  Now, the Q did think for several minutes the night berfore and nearly lowered the amount.  But "if you can't do it, don't Q it, you know what?  Screw it."  So 25 manmakers led off one of four stations that had 25 reps of 4 exercises.  We ran some in between and finished with speedball.  Kudos to Sega for making a fingertip catch of a poorly thrown touchdown pass.
In the COT, everyone silently assented that they should sign up to Q the Catbox,  because if Grandpa Chubbs can do it, then anyone can.
Also, we didn't pray for anyone present today, so we can assume that everyone's lives are just peachy.  We did pray for Blackhawk and that God would heal him.
The End.

backblasts.title: Don't Believe the Hype
backblasts.body:
I filled in for PB who was not able to make it.  The PAX was notified that there was going to be a special guest Q for the morning.  Much to the dismay of the PAX, it was me.  A specific quote I heard, "special he is always here".  Yet I pushed on.  Stayed up late making a beat down with an accompanying play list.  I was very excited.  Song #2 on my list (which is actually #1 in my heart) Eddie Money's classic, Take Me Home Tonight came on.  Clearly members of the PAX do not appreciate culture and the song was skipped.  Sadness filled my heart, yet I pushed on.  I am now inspired!  My next Q will be the soundtrack to our hearts, Eddie Money from start to finish.
Warm Up: The Usual
The Thang:
Groups of three: Station 1 and 2 were exercises, 3 was run to other end of parking lot, 3 burpees, run back.  Rotate stations.
There were various combinations of the following exercises:  merkins, dry docks, mike tysons, shoulder taps, squats, lunges, hammers, big boys, lbcs.
COT:  My cousins daughter Katie, 3 week child and mom has to get lung removed for cancer.

THE THANG: I took Q last night because PB was unable to make it. Ice T mentioned in slack that a there was a special guest Q today.  During the mosey I heard a someone say “how is this special, he is here all of the time?”. A valid point so we moved on.  I was up late preparing the BD as well as the accompanying playlist to complement the exercise. The second song was Eddy Money’s Take me Home Tonight.  Although it was second on my list, it is first in my heart.  Morning is going great. During my run, someone skips the rest of the song. Do they not have 2 ears and a soul.  Try to bring a little culture to the Den, instead I have to deal with anti-Moneyiteism. No worries, next beat down, all Eddy Money, all the time.

COT:

Ringpop was six man but he delegated that to YHC, the elder pop. YHC talked about praying for impossible situations. Like a friend and recent FNG whose 3rd marriage was all but over. Wife had already filed for divorce. Had a restraining order against him. The divorce and split was pretty much a done deal. And yet. Because this friend is a Christian and we are called to pray for God to perform impossible miracles. We prayed for the situation nonetheless. To our amazement, the wife was convicted at church a couple of Sundays ago and stopped the divorce proceedings and also pulled the restraining order. A lot of soul searching happened in between with some direct intervention into the lives of both parties by various men and women of God. But still. YHC considers it a miracle. An to YHC's shame, too. Because while we are called to pray for miracles, how often do we actually expect them to come about? How cynical are we about them when they do? YHC's exhortation to the Pax was to consider the attitude of Ezekiel in Ezekiel 37 in the valley of the dry bones. In it, God asks "Son of man, can these dry bones live?" to which Ezekiel is wise enough to know not to tell God what He can't do. "O Lord God, you know". Pray for impossible situations. Have faith that God can raise that which is dead to life. This is the beating heart of Christianity. This is the good news.
In COT we prayed for Chuck's brother who is in prison and needs an impossible miracle and also Sleepy Joe's job interviewing progress.
After COT, Sleepy Joe expressed his great displeasure at YHC for not wearing suits to work. YHC is a programmer. Suits are foreign and therefore anathema to him. Sleepy Joe made an impassioned plea for YHC to at least try wearing a dress shirt.
…
…
…
YHC is writing this in jeans and a Kubernetes t-shirt.

backblasts.title: Summer Surfin' Safari
backblasts.body:
Dude, it was awesome.
The Summer Surfin' Safari beat down left us stoked for the day!
We moseyed and all that, then did Knuckle-draggers across the field and back. The did Super Tubes, which is a Superman, then popping up to your feet, and then 10 overhead presses all X 50 and then Knuckle-draggers across the field again. All the while, rad Hustler was explaining things about surfing. No way!
Way.
Then on to a mini-murph to honor Lt. Michael Murphy as well as Sean Murphy to whom Hustler sold — yes, you guessed it — a surfboard to for a Sid Vicious cassette tape and $10 cash in eighth grade. Bargain. 50 pull ups, 100 merks and 150 squats, then a run.
The final event was wind sprints, with the PAX in two groups, and the first jogging halfway of a 100 yard dash, and then sprinting to the end with the other group trying to catch them once the first group reached midway. Than flapjack, and it was time.
That lovely word: Time!
We prayed for Chuck to find a sweet babe, Boondock's babe, Blarney schooling + career, Landing Strip's world and Blowpop's new rad gig and hot waves.
…everything to gnarly surf tunes.
Dude, it was awesome.

backblasts.body:
Today is Q one of three for YHC’s second manniversary. With the weather, I was somewhat concerned that the beatdown would be canceled.

Running Sixes Rd.

– Change the direction of run

– A 10# sandbag was also added to this, each PAX took a turn carrying the sandbag.

We got about 20 minutes into the run then headed back towards the flag because of the weather.
Landing Strip was not feeling too comfortable with the weather, so he decided to take off.

The Thang = 4 locations throughout the site.  Pavilion (bench station), in the Cat Box (pull up station), in the Black Hole, and on the curb.  Total lap of the 4 locations is about .35 miles with a large hill from the Black Hole to the Curb.  At each station the Pax completes 20 of whatever exercise/lap that they are on.  Exercises below.
Station 1
Lap 1 – 20 Box Jumps
Lap 2 – Derkins
Lap 3 – Single Leg Lunges with 1 foot on bench
(20 each leg)
Lap 4 – Carolina Dry Docks
(feet on bench)
Station 2

Lap 2 – Pull-ups (or burpees)
Lap 3 – plank in and outs (feet on swings)
Lap 4 – Pull-ups (or Burpees)
Station 3

Champions Run
We first took a mosey around the track and warmed up with ssh, copperhead merkins, copperhead squats and of course the weedpicker.
We sprinted to the pavilion to start the horror.
The rule was, when a champion (whoever finishes first) is done with the exercise, everyone finished the exercise but then that person could no longer be a champion.
After each set of exercises we run the 1/4 mile lap.
The exercises:
30 burpees and 50 ssh
50 merkins and 50 squats
50 birddogs X2 and 50 lbc's
50 alternate supermans X2 and 50 scissor kicks
50 step ups and 50 merkins
30 burpee and reverse burpees (alarm clock) together
Rinse and Repeat.
Last 15 minutes was speedball where the team without jerseys just absolutely dominated the field.  It wasnt even fair.  First time I have ever seen grown men crying at speedball, it was a sight.  We ended it 30 seconds early just so the losing team could compose themselves and headed to the pavilion.

The men of Oz received a nice reminder of a video game most of us are familiar with and when I say most of us, pretty much everyone maybe minus the 2.0s (Ringpop & Chicken Fight). Before getting into the juicy details, of the game and all that stuff…
We started our Warmorama with a mosey up to Sixes and held the rest of the WOR in the grass at the road’s edge. To get our bodies moving we did SSH, Weed Pickers (fan favorite), Windmills, Imperial Walkers, Sun Gods, and Michael Phelps.

Next, we moseyed down to the parking lot on the west side of the church for The Thang.

3-6-9 Feeling Fine
200 yards with cones every 10 yards
Start
3 Burpee
6 BBS
9 OJ Squats
Run to the next cone (rinse & repeat)
@ white cones (every 50 yds), do the exercises then run to the last white cone then back to the first, then to your next cone.
Seeing all the cones set up was a reminder of Pac-Man.

Next we made our way over to the coupons to grab a coupon for the next leg of The Thang.

Coupon Shuttle
Run across parking lot with coupon, drop coupon in grass, run back
10 merkins
Bear crawl to end of parking stripes, run to grass & retrieve coupon, then run back
10 press jacks
2 rounds
Run across parking lot with coupon, drop coupon in grass, run back
10 Pie Bar Shoulder Taps
Broad jump to end of parking stripes, run to grass & retrieve coupon, then run back
10 flutter kicks (2 count)
2 rounds
Somewhere in the middle of this, Ringpop tries to mumble a word under his breath, but I think it came out a little louder than he expected and both Blowpop and I heard it. It brought some laughter to it all in the end.

30s High Plank

COT

backblasts.title: Put It All On 7, Baby
backblasts.body:
"7"
Soggy, dark and cold. Just the way the Men of Oz like it. Yes it was a perfect day to do some rolling around in the mud. And having just returned from Vegas, and having lost money, I wanted to inflict pain on Blowpop, Boonie, Dump, Chicken Fight, Ring Pop and myself.
I am not sure if anyone had Q'ed the infamous "7 Of Diamonds" workout before, so that was the First Thang. It goes like this …
Set up a diamond, like a baseball diamond, in a field.
Seven rounds with each round being a multiple of 7.
Round 1: 7 burpees at each corner.
Round 2: 14 merkins at each
Round 3: 21 IW's
Round 4: 28 squats
Round 5 (descending): 21 IW's
Round 6: 14 merkins
Round 7: 7 burpees
We all pretty much got it done, and we moved on to Thang 2.
7's
We did 1 4×4, ran 70 yards and did 6 squats. Then 2 4x4s and 5 squats, down to 6 4x4s and 1 squat.
Ring Pop (or was it Chicken) finished, but the rest of us couldn't before 6:15.
We prayed for a friend of mine Denniis' health, Dump's family, Roscoe P's foot, and other things, which we know God will take care of.
We a great group. What a blessing to know these guys. What a better option than fartsacking.
Peace. Out.

backblasts.title: Monkey Humpers Awareness Day
backblasts.body:
This was a beat down dedicated to the greatness of Monkey Humpers.
A Short Fictional History of the Monkey Humper
The origins of the Monkey Humper are humble.  
Invented by Dr. Montague Humper in 1969, the exercise that bears his surname came into being after too many Q’s repeatedly skipped leg day.  One day, at an ancient site known only as The Lions Den, Dr. Humper witnessed several men struggling to mount a rather steep hill during one workout.  As a world renowned primate proctologist, Dr. Humper knew that monkeys never struggle with leg strength and the Monkey Humper was born. 
At one time, the Monkey Humper was the #1 ranked exercise in the world.  In recent years, due to scandal and financial mismanagement, the monkey humper’s reputation has been unjustly tarnished.  Monkey Humpers Awareness Day is an effort to restore this vital part of our nation’s history to its rightful place.
The workout began with a light warmup including SSHs, Copperhead Merkins & Squats, and complaining about unequal reps of Tumbleweeds.  The Q courageously fought through the complaining.
The Thang was a Dora done in pairs with 100 Mike Tysons, 200 Butterfly BBS, and 300 Squats.  One member of the team did the exercises while the other member ran to the tree line, completed 10 Monkey Humpers, and Bernie Sanders'd back.  It was really fun.  Especially the Monkey Humpers.  After the completion of the first Dora each team did a half mile lap and repeated the Dora.
Everyone agreed never to skip leg day ever again.  Ever.
Prayer requests: Izzys upcoming surgery, gratitude for a good report on a melanoma scare, thanks for an addiction recovery anniversary, thanks for a new job and opportunity to "double dip" for a month

Run 150m

 Catbox Relay
PAX was divided up into 2 teams. Each member had to complete the relay.
Run down the hill to the monkey bars to complete 10 pull ups.
Run to cone in grass field to complete 20 squats.
Run back to the swings for 20 Derkins.
Run back to the pavilion – next pax then moved onto the course.

20 BBS
20 Lunges
20 LBS
20 Merkins
20 American Hammers
Once this was completed, the team that won the race had 3 blind options to choose from for a punishment for losing team. Options: Deck of Cards, or two other exercises written on cards inside envelops.
Choice was:
Losing Team – 60 squats – everytime you stop: 5 pull ups, 10 Merkins
Winning Team – 5 rounds: 2 pull ups, 5 merkins, 10 swats
Once losing team completed, we then moseyed to the beach volleyball pits.

 Sand Relay
Each team selected 5 PAX on their team to complete this relay.
This started by running to the middle of the first pit and complete 5 burpees.
Then broad jump to the second pit and complete 20 plank jacks.
Then broad jump to the third pit and complete 20 hand release merkins.
Then run back to the starting line.
As the PAX waited they competed a series of exercises (rinse & repeat):
20 Squats
Alphabet
10 Mike Tysons
10 Bobby Hurleys
Once this was completed, the team that won the race had 3 blind options to choose from for a punishment for losing team. Options: Deck of Cards, or two other exercises written on cards inside envelops.

Choice was:
Losing Team – run 1 lap (400 m) – 20 merkins, 20 squats, 20 BBS
Winning Team – 20 merkins, 20 squats, 20 BBS
This would have said “Once losing team completed,” some PAX went MIA. QIC decided to mosey to the site of the 3rd relay. We found the MIA PAX.

 Basketball Court/hill Relay
In the interest of ending on time, QIC made this a 2 PAX from each team race. But, the two PAX competing did not run in the volleyball pit relay.
This started by bear crawling up the hill and complete 20 wide merkins.
Then lung walk to the space between the two courts and complete 20 hillbillies.
Then lung walk to the furtherest side line and complete 10 foxholes.
Then run back to the starting line.

As the PAX waited they competed a series of exercises (rinse & repeat):
If a car passes – stop everything and 10 monkey humpers
10 Imperial Squat Walkers
20 Flutter Kicks
20 Box Cutters
20 Plank Jacks
Once this was completed, the team that won the race had 3 blind options to choose from for a punishment for losing team. Options: Deck of Cards, or two other exercises written on cards inside envelops.

Choice was:
Losing Team – 100 BBS every time you stop: 10 merkins, 15 squats
Winning Team – 5 rounds – 10 BBS, 5 merkins, 5 squats
Ending this in time to mosey back to the pavilion for COT, the punishment workout was cut short by the QIC.

Once back at the pavilion we circled up for 2 minutes of Mary until stopex.

Cookies & Cream had 6th man – discussing how he has passed his written test to join Marietta fire and that he is looking forward to the physical test.

Piano Man’s upcoming eye surgery
Oshkosh’s sister Lisa and her kids as she is sick and her husband is deployed
Backdraft’s friends (the Williams family) as the anniversary of their son’s death approaches
All PAX as they head out and return from summer vacations

– 3 rounds – 60 second toe taps on the curb, with a 30 second rest between rounds

Ray Lewis was next. I pulled out a deck of cards and we completed the prescribed exercise according to the suit. Ray Lewis used a deck of cards for his workout when he was a child. That was the reason he wore 52.

Reps we done according to number on card.

Ace = 1 rep

Jack = 11 Reps

Queen = 12 Reps

King = 13 Reps

Hearts – Burpees

Diamonds – Foxhole

Spades – Imperial Squatters

Clubs – 4 count Plank Jack

Rules of the game:

– only 2.0 were allowed to shoot in the paint

– miss a shot and the other team rebounds = 8 merkins for the shooter

– miss a shot and your team gets the rebound = no penalty

– allow a score = 24 merkins for the whole team

We paired off in 9 groups where one partner would run lap while the other completed AMRAP beatdown exercises starting with A.  When the partner would return from the run they would switch places.  As the 2nd partner completed their run, the team would then choose a random card from the deck and complete the associated number of reps from the card per the suit that was drawn together.  2-Ace (11) with Jokers counting as 10 of each suit.  Upon team completion, first partner would take off running and 2nd partner began exercise B, and so forth.  The goal was to collect the best five card hand during the beatdown.  Cue the Salsa Music!

backblasts.title: Science Project Beat Down
backblasts.body:
SCIENCE!
This was a science project because we worked from a classic science project tri-fold foam core board that showed our exercises. One side was one of my son's actual science projects (it was very confusing), and the other side was the Thangs… very scientific. We also learned what happens when a speaker runs out of battery charge. Very, very scientific. We all learned a lot. Although it was not scientific, and had more to do with social studies, both Chicken Fight and Ringpop learned how to dance, courtesy of YHC and Hitch (the movie, not the PAX).
Let me say that Chicken Fight and Ringpop were also there, but their names are not in the drop-down menu.
Let's go…
Circle up for the Warm-Up of SSH, windmills, and other stuff.
Mosey
First Thang:
DORA 1-2-3
Partnered up. One PAX did the exercise and kept count while the other ran a circuit. Flapjacked on the return and picked up on the count until done 100 merkins (arms), 200 LBCs (core) and 300 squats.
Mosey
Second Thang…
BLIMPs.
This is an escalator that starts with 5 burpees, and a run, then 5 burpees plus 10 lunges and a run, always adding an exercise until you've done burpees, lunges, imperial walkers, merkins, plank jacks and squats. A few of the PAX — Rocket Man, Cannonball, Chicken Fight and Ring Pop — completed them all before time was called.
At one point Chicken Fight and his brother Ring Pop started arguing about whether Ring did his 5 burpees or not. It got ugly. JK. Blowpop,  said, "Hey, no talking."
I had never heard anyone say that at a beat down.
But since Ringpop was not the Q, I said. "Hey, old man. This is my Q. I'll give the orders here. Hey, Ring Pop and Chicken Fight — No Talking."
Having nipped that in the bud, we moseyed to the flag for Marys for 5 minutes. Rocket Man called flutter kicks, Blowpop called box cutters, Dump Truck did sexy Jane Fondas and Chicken Fight called 1-10 squats. Whew.
Cannon Ball was the 6th man, and he talked about redemptive suffering, and how our attitude about life's struggles is so important. You can look at challenges as a victim or as an opportunity to find the joy and be stronger because of them. Thanks, Cannon Ball. I think that's a message we should all hear every day!
We prayed for Dump Trucks friends who may be in transition in their lives. We prayed for Cannon Ball for peace in his young family. For the students there — RP, CF and RM — for focus in their studies, and for the men there, that we may prioritize correctly and focus on the most import work we need to do today.
YHC was almost a science project of his own when he nearly splashed merlot but only enjoyed some dry heaving. I had been traveling and had not beat down since April 14, and it's not always easy to jump back into F3 at 55 years old, but now I feel great!
It's good to be back in the gloom with my brothers!

We started with mosey, then circle. I mentioned that at the 3rdF Breakfast, Bloodhound had said he sees F3 turning into a race at the expense of form, so we tried to focus on form today. Also, I emphasized picking up the 6 after you finish every exercise as opposed to doing planks or Mary until they are done.
Warms ups were SSH, windmills (which Exile did at the 3rd F beatdown and which help loosen those hammies, plus they are a good warmup for weedpickers as @Fleetwood pointed out), weedpickers, imperial walkers and some Copperhead squats and CH merkins and other stuff.
We built BLIMPS escalating with a run in between each.
Moseyed to the shelter where I showed the PAX the new picnic table I bought. Then 11 with dips up top and pullups in the kitty litter and picked up ithe 6.
Mosey to the field where were did crabcrawls (my least fave exercise) across and back and then three burpees then picked up the 6.
Then SPEEDBALL! Team No. 2, The Jets, won 2-1. Fleetwood finally got a chance to be on skins to show off how freaking ripped he is. No one got injured this time, I know, weird.
Mary till 7:30am. Tack was the 6. We prayed for his girls and his father, whom they are visiting in FL; Cathy Meeler, Jeane Heinze, that the guys at Savage Race did well and stayed injury free.  Prayers, no announcments,
Catbox was a little light today because several of the regulars — Backdraft, PB, Odd Job, Couchfire and Rugburn I think — were at the Savage Race.
I coudl not find them on the drop-downs, but Lefluer, Rubber Duckie, Ringpop, Chicken Fight — the Lost Boys also kicked butt.
Even without them, it was pretty great. Nay, perfect.

backblasts.title: I cant count
backblasts.body:
We started with a mosey around the 1/4 mile track until we circled up in the parking lot to start what I thought would be a nice few exercises t get us started.  That did not happen.  My given name is Callahan and in true "Tommy Callahan" fashion I screwed this up to an unrecognizable series of events that left everyone screaming at me and made me doubt that I would ever work out again.  I dont know how many of the these were performed as the count did not go as planned but we did some number of these:
Side Straddle Hops
Copperhead Merkins
Imperial Walkers
Weed Pickers
I quickly tried to transition into the next part of the Q which was the crazy 8's:
We started with 7 burpees on top of the pavement and 1 squat to the bottom of the road and continued until we finished with 7 squats and 1 burpee.
Next we ran up to the pavilion and started the main workout called "the classic" to work the abs, arms, chest, arms and cardio.
Station 1: run 1/4 mile of the track
Station 2: 40 big boys
Station 3: 12 pull-ups
Station 4: 30 merkins
Every group was able to do at least 4 rounds of these stations and with 15 minutes left.
Next we played Speedball, keep in mind it has rained hard for the past 24 hours and just stopped raining at 0500 this morning.  It was a little wet.  Only 8 people fell and slid.  Tackleberry fell twice but kept coming back for more, I am not sure why.  Sega had the most impressive fall, but also the most impressive performance and was voted MVP of the team.
We left a trail of mud and grass on our way back to the pavilion to end with Dufresne as 6th man.  We are all wishing the best for him as his family as Dufresne and his wife are empty nesters and his sons are both doing well in school.
I am thankful for this group of men, rest up and look forward to seeing everyone next week.

The Q was kind of a jerk.  So….many….merkins…..
We warmed up in the typical manner with a slow mosey, SSHs, weedpickers (yea!), copperhead merkins, and Sun gods (in cadence) to get those shoulders all limbered up.
In the interest of March Merkin Madness, we did a series of 4 exercises capped off with a 20 merkins/derkins at the conclusion of each set.  Each set was followed by a 1/4 mile lap.  We nearly made it through this routine twice, before the Q was too merkin'd out to continue.  Then it got worse.  Inspired by Cookies N' Cream's example, the PAX proceed to do a set of 11s with burpees at one end and…..more burpees at the other end.  During the second round, the guy next to the Q started snarling "Chubbs is my enemy" with every burpee.
It was fun for all.  And we did more than 3400 merkins as a group this morning (yep, we counted).  How's THAT for madness.

backblasts.title: Three Pillars of Fitness
backblasts.body:
Mosey and Warmo
The Thang: There are (depending on who you ask) three pillars of fitness: endurance, speed, and strength (we don't do flexibility in F3). PAX split into three groups and rotating between three 10-minute stations. One speed station, one power station, and one endurance station. Power station was in the cat box, which consisted of 10 minutes of 60 second EMOM work with coupons. Exercises included thrusters, swings, pull-ups, derkins, step ups with coupon, and Louganis, and coupon hop burpees. Speed station was in the blackhole. This consisted of a traditional BBall sprint ladder. Sprint length of court and back (so, 2 lengths). Rest 20-30 seconds. Sprint 4 lengths. Rinse and repeat all the way to 12 (this station sucked). Endurance station was running laps. Goal was to get a mile in.
We then played a spirited game of speedball, which is under protest due to the shirts intentionally stacking their team.

backblasts.title: The Lord of the Flies
backblasts.body:
AKA The day we lost our minds and let the lost boys lead us into a world of shoulder pain
Lost boys present: Chicken Fight, Rubber Ducky, LaFleur, and Ringpop
What happened to Backdraft?
Warm up
Chicken Fight lead the group on a long and brisk mosey around the track to the parking lot next to the field where we did 10 side straddle hops, 15 merkins, and 10 copperhead merkins. Multiple requests for the F3 Bridgemill favorite of weed pickers were denied.
The thang
Started on the parking lot side of the field we were introduced to a new (and awful) mode of transportation "spinning planks" to get to the first set of markers in the field. Spinning planks start in a plank position and progress is made down the field by moving one arm up into a side plank position and then continuing that motion until you are facing up in a dip position and then moving your other arm up into a side plank position. Apparently this is what some kids do these days in lieu of drugs.
After finally reaching the first marker we performed 50 merkins and started to head back to the sidewalk.
Then the first mutiny broke out against the spinning planks. We explained to Chicken Fight that men get dizzy faster as they age. So Chicken Fight changed out the mode of transportation from spinning planks to bear crawls and we continued heading back to the sidewalk.
We then bear crawled from the side walk to the next distance marker where we did 100 squats. Then we bear crawled back to the first marker where we did 50 dadgum merkins again before bear crawling back to the sidewalk.
Chicken Fight then had mercy on the old men and modified the mode of transportation from bear crawls to Bernie Sanders and we continued on to the third marker where we did 50 Michael Phelps. Chicken Fight meant to have us do Mike Tysons. Thank God he doesn't know the difference between boxing and swimming, yet.
Ran back to the sidewalk, stopping for squats and merkins along the way. Wait for the 6 to get in before continuing to round two. While waiting on the 6th we were introduced to another monstrosity created by the Lost Boys known as "The Rave". The Rave is a combination of air presses and imperial walkers performed at the same time.
For round two we bear crawled to the first marker and performed Weapons of Mass Destruction. These are Wide merkins, Merkins and Diamond merkins.
This is when the second mutiny occurred.
Chicken Fight wanted us to perform 50 of these. Pie Bar submitted a brief arguing for the Q to modify the count from 50 to 15. Chicken Fight reluctantly accepted this modification. The audience cheered. The BD continued.
Back to the sidewalk and then on to the second marker where we did 50 hand release merkins. Upon further inquiry about the excessive shoulder exercises Chicken Fight revealed that he chose this particular exercise because he knew his father, Blowpop, dislikes it the most. Sorry guys.
Back to the sidewalk, stopping at the first marker to perform WMDs, and then on to the third marker where we did 50 burpees. Apparently we have Ringpop to thank for this one.
Back to the sidewalk, stopping at the second marker for hand release merkins, and then the first marker where several pax modified WMDs into a deconstructed form where we performed the W's M's and D's separately.
Performed The Rave until the 6th was in.
Then Rubber Ducky then took over and lead us back to the pavilion where we picked up a soccer ball and some cones and then ran back down to the field where we split into two teams. Crabs and bears. The ball was placed in the middle of the field and at Rubber Ducky's signal crabs crab walked to the ball and bears bear crawled to the ball and we played a version of soccer that only someone on acid trip would dream up. This insanity of bears battling crabs lasted for approximately two minutes before we moseyed back to the flag.
Back at the flag we circled up and did 100 weed pickers. We would have done more but another mutiny broke out and we elected to "gamble" with the Q which led to us doing 1 to 10 squats. 1 to 10 squats start with 10 squats where we hold on the 10th for 10 seconds. This is where the PAX learned about the physical phenomenon of "youth  time dilation" where 1 second can seemingly stretch into 10. That, or Rubber Ducky simply has no mercy for his elders. I believe I heard the moment 800's legs gave out. Hope that guy pulls through.
We then started to perform 1 to 10 merkins when time gave out.
COT
We ended in a circle of trust where Chubbs was the 6th man. He offered some words of wisdom from our combined 2nd F and Theology on Tap event this past Tuesday about marriage being based on commitment to the sacred oaths we swore to our brides and not about the feeling of love we may have because that feeling ebbs and flows over time. Chubbs encouraged us to all try and recall the vows we made to our wives, and to even recite them with our wives. And he challenged the Lost Boys to take the vows they may one day make seriously.
We then had our two FNGs step up and introduce themselves.
The first  FNG told us about his past and how he is a professional electronic dance music host and beat boxer. Of course we asked him to demonstrate for us. He obliged. The beat was dope and the PAX felt the groove. We named him Freestyle.
The second FNG told us about his love of guitars and Karate so we named him Daniel-san.
We announced the upcoming 3rd F breakfast on Friday and Pie Bar announced a fundraiser he's putting together for a CHOA which is connected to a CHOA nurse his family has been ministering to. Details to follow in Slack.
Prayers were offered for the prayer requests mentioned. YHC doesn't recall them all. Neither did the Q.
Coffee and doughnuts were had. Thanks Ice T!
The jury is still out on whether Chicken Fight will be allowed to Q again at the Catbox. I'm sure if he Q's again, though, there won't be any mutinies.

SSH, WP, MMPs

Butkis' on the curb, drop to do merkins on my count, start with 5, add a merkin every time up to 15, speed kicks up

COT

6th man – Cookies and Cream – good word to find passion and motivation to achieve your goals.

Prayers for PAX

Maple Bourbon Coffee for the win

backblasts.title: Turning Lions to Cheetahs
backblasts.body:
Lost Boys: LaFleur, Rubber Ducky, Piano Man
Plan for today was to disrupt a safe space. TLD is known around Cherokee County for harboring those who hate running. So, I bring the running to TLD every chance I get. today was no different.
Mosey down to the lower lot for some squats and Michael Phelps. PAX didn't like that this ended our warmup. it was a Maaco style warmup.
Thang 1: Had PAX form 2 lines for Native American Appropriation Run with a twist… first two PAX would sprint off as far as they thought they needed to complete 5 Bro Merkins before the lines met them. if the lines caught up everyone performed 5 penalty burpees.
Warmup 2: Weed Pickers and some sungods. that's all we needed.
Thang 2: Profanity Merkins
15 Merkins in cadence followed by a 45sec plank. brief rest, 14 Merkins in cadence followed by 40sec plank, 13/35, 12/30… we held here b/c the PAX were starting to lose faith in their arm muscles.
Thang 3: Partner up. Partner 1 runs a lap around the lower lot while Partner 2 does AMRAP. AMRAP exercises are as follows:
Peter Parker Burpees
Lunge, Sumo Squat, Lunge
Dips
Merkin, Plank Jack (2x), Merkin
American Hammers
JLo
Superman Hold
Captain Thor
LBSBCs (Little Baby Sidebend Crunch)
Flutter Kicks
Indian Run to mosey back
Thoughts on the day… 37 PAX is far too many for any sort of organized activity… especially in a place where everyone hates running. 2.5mi isn't too bad for a TLD beatdown and my arms are pretty spent at this point. Will I Q this again? Yes, maybe even sooner than later. Will the TLD PAX ever like running? The world may never know

backblasts.title: CATBOX - Black Ops
backblasts.body:
Lost Boys were with us as well, Chicken Fight, Ring Pop, LeFluer, Rubber Ducky.

This Special Edition Catbox was a Black Ops beatdown. We wanted to support our brother Pie Bar while Izzy was in the hospital. The usual Catbox crew met at the AO, then half of us hopped in cars and sped down to a park close the Children's Hospital.
The THING: After a short mosey and warm up we dove right in.
Bear in the Woods: Bear Crawl 5 paces and poop (back half of Mike Tyson) until you repack 25 paces total. Then Crawl Bear 5 paces and sniff (Dry Dock) until you reach 25 paces. Then execute 20 Mike Tysons. Repeat Bear in the Woods then execute 25 Merkins.
Run Totals: Parter up. Parter 1 runs across field and back. Partner 2 executes an exercise to accumulate a total. 100 BBS, 200 Merkins, 300 Squats.
Bucket of Death: My go to. Each PAX grabs a small black with an exercise written on it and form a circle. We place the block in front of us and execute said exercise for a minute, then rotate clockwise to the next spot and execute what is written on that spot's block. We all complete the full circle.
Sprints: We divide the group in two and line up single file facing each other about 40 yards apart. One PAX starts by sprinting full speed towards the other group. When the runner tags the pax at the front of the other line that pax then sprints across and tags the next pax. We completed 3 full rotations then executed 5 burpees. 10 count, Then repeat another 3 full rotations of sprints. Glorious.
COT: PB was very appreciative of those that made the trip down to support him and his family. It was great for all of us to be there for him.

The Lion's Den always has insane numbers, but they do not have an insane amount of PAX step up to Q especially the newer PAX.  YHC came to the Den to rectify that.
Short mosey, and we circled up for a few warm up exercises.  It was YHC, so I am sure it was merkins and phelps.  YHC then split the massive group in two.  One group was PAX that have been in F3 over two years.  The other was less than 2 years.  The majority of Q's at the Den come from the older PAX, so YHC had the Q sheet printed out and laid it on the ground in front of the new PAX.  At this time, YHC advised the entire group that we would do Burpee Bonnie Blairs until the new guys filled up the Q sheet for the first quarter of the year.  It took about 5 minutes, but we got 14 Q slots filled with 8 of them being VQ's.  F3 is an organization of leaders, and we need leaders to step up and Q.  I am thankful that these PAX stepped up especially the VQ's.

See pic for BD that proceeded.  It went something like that.  Crawl bears up hill really are awful.

backblasts.body:
When I signed up for this Q the Dawgs were ranked number 3. Had I known they'd be in the Championship game I may have signed up for the Thursday BD. Either way it's always an honor to lead the men of the Den.
Warm-o-rama: Quick lap followed by some SSH, Weed Pickers, Merkins, Imperial Walkers, Sun Gods, and wrist shakers. Ready to take the field.
The Thing:
In 27 degree weather we needed to get the blood pumping. So, to celebrate the Dawgs big win we started with 1st and 10's. Using the bus lanes we started at Lane 1 and executed 10 Merkins / 1 Burpee. We then ran to Lane 10 and back to Lane 2 where we executed 9 Merkins / 2 Burpees. Then run to Lane 10 then back to Lane 3 for 8 Merkins / 3 Burpees. Keep going until we finished at Lane 10 with 1 Merkin / 10 Burpees. Brutal.
Next we formed a circle and executed the Bucket of Death. Each pax grabs a block from the bucket and places it on the ground at his spot. Each block has an exercise written on it. One Pax runs a lap (1:00) while everyone else does the exercise they chose from the bucket. When the runner returns we all rotate one spot to execute that spot's exercise while the next runner does his lap. After 20 minutes we have completed a full body beatdown.
With some time left on the clock we partnered up to execute 100 combined Big Boy Sit-ups. One pax runs to bus Lane 20 while the other does sit-ups.
The Bucket of Death makes for an easy Q, but more importantly it allows for plenty of chatter among bros.
COT: Prayers for strength and guidance to face our battles. Love and Compassion for those in need.

backblasts.title: 25 Days of Bucket
backblasts.body:
Always an honor to Q The Lions Den, especially two days before Christmas.
Warm-o-rama: Short lap followed by side straddle hops, merkins, squats, weed-pickers and wrist shakers.
The THING:
Using the numbered bus lanes we executed the 25 days of Christmas.
Sprint to Lane 5 and do 5 OJ Squats, air chair on the 6.
Sprint to Lan2 10 do 5 Merkins, plank on the 6
Sprint to Lane 15 do 5 Big Boy Situps, LBCs on the 6.
Sprint to Lane 20 do 5 Mike Tysons, Mountain Climbers on the 6.
Sprint to Lane 25 do 5 Bonne Blairs, calf raises on the 6.
Repeat 3 times
Next up, The Bucket of Death: Form a circle, then each pax grabs a small block out of the Home Depot paint bucket. Each block has an exercise written on it. One pax runs a lap (1;00-1:30) while the rest of us execute their selected exercise. When the running brother returns a new pax begins his lap while we all rotate one position and do the exercise written on that position's block.
Including
Merkins
Leg Raises
Squats
Burpees
Curls (30lb)
Block Press
Ball toss (20lb)
OJ Squats
LBCs
Mike Tysons
Flings (30lb)
Mountain Climbers
ETC…
Resulted in a fullbody cardio beatdown.
Next up, 4- Corner GRONKS: Set up 4 cones in a square, each about 25 yards apart. at corner 1 the Pax form a single file line. At corner 2, 3, and 4 a single pax stands, corner 4 has the football. To start, corner 4 throws the ball diagonally to corner 2. The pax at 2 then throws to corner 3. Then everyone sprint rotates counter-clock wise. A new pax sprints from corner 1 to corner 2 to corner 2 to receive the pass from corner 4, Rinse and repeat until everyone has caught and thrown. Every dropped pass is 5 burpees. We did a lot of burpees.
Lastly through a series of personal and trivia questions a single brother was selected to receive a new Santa coffee cup.
Merry Christmas. Sorry for the late Backblast!

backblasts.title: What is QSource?… 5 BURPEES
backblasts.body:
WOR
Mosey, SSHs, WeedPickers, Imperial Walkers, Merkins, SunGods…
The Thang!
Time for some Q Source Trivia!
What is Q Source? – 5 Burpees! QSOURCE: The F3 Manual Of Virtuous Leadership
Leadership is a skill that a person must learn & master during their lifetime
Because we are all born with some leadership ability.
QSource is designed to be used by F3 members to improve their leadership skills for the benefit of their families, workplaces and neighborhoods.
How many QPoints comprise the QSource?  50 – 5 burpees.
How many Foundational Q Points are there? 5 – 5 burpees
F1/Disruption: Disturbance To The Status Quo
F2/Language: The Lexicon Of Effective Leadership
F3/Group: A Voluntary Combination Of Two Or More People
F4/LDP: The Process Employed By A Group To Develop New Leaders
F5/Preparedness: Getting Ready For The Expected While Being Ready For The Unexpected
Quadrants of Preparedness are there?  4 – 5 burpees (think they actually got that one right).
Can anyone name the First Quadrant? – 5 penalty burpees
The First Quadrant: Get Right
Q1/Get Right: The Pursuit Of Proper Personal Alignment
A man must get right before he can do anything else
An unfit man is a slave to his lack of self-control
To be able to help others, a man must first help himself
7’s – up the hill by the parking lot, Diamond Merkins on top and Monkey Humpers at bottom.
Can anyone name the Second Quadrant? – 5 penalty burpees
The Second Quadrant: Live Right
Q2/Live Right: The Dedication To Purposefulness
To Live Right a man must have an ultimate purpose in mind
To Live Right requires self-sacrifice
Living Right helps a man to stay right
DORA (50 Merkins, 100 LBC’s, 200 Squats) then switch partners and wheelbarrowed for a bit. 
Can anyone name the Third Quadrant? – 5 penalty burpees.
The Third Quadrant: Lead Right
Q3/Lead Right: The Practice Of Virtuous Leadership
The leadership skills are the four capabilities of effective leadership that enable a man to do what a leader does Vision, Articulation, Persuasion and Exhortation (VAPE)
The leadership virtues are the five habits and ethics of moral excellence that enable a man to be who a leader is candor, commitment, consistency, contentment and courage – The 5 C’s
To Lead Right a person must be both an effective & virtuous leader
Break into small groups to lead an exercise (5-10 minutes)
Can anyone name the Fourth Quadrant? – 5 penalty burpees.
The Fourth Quadrant : Leave Right
Q4/Leave Right: The Construction Of Legacy
Only a virtuous leader can leave a legacy
A HIM seeks the solution to his ultimate life problem
Legacy is constructed through the HIM’s development of virtuous leaders
Mosey to flag for Mary (5-10 minutes)
COT:
Challenge to establish a Q Source group (Q of Q Source) or to Join.  Announcements.  Prayers.

At the bottom of this hill we started with 1 4 count flutter kick, ran to the top of the hill where we did 11 merkins. Rinse, repeat. We got through 3-4 rounds before mosying back to the flag for COT.

COT

In the COT we counted off and did a name-o-rama. Roscoe was the 6th man. He shared a word about forgiveness and how it is good and necessary not only to forgive but to be humble in choosing to forget offenses committed against us. The quote he gave us was

“Jesus taught us how to forgive out of love, how to forget out of humility.” ― Mother Teresa

Backdraft also spoke. He cited this week's newsletter and Foosball's recent 3rd F talk which included mention of suicide being prevalent especially during this time of year where the gloom can and does get to many men. If you are going to that dark place in your mind reach out! There is a great number of Pax in our region that would drop everything to merely come and sit with you to pull you back from the abyss.

Announcements included options for Pax to spread Christmas cheer this season by participating in giving campaigns.

This is the one that Blowpop mentioned. It's helping raise money to help a fellow F3 Cherokee Pax out by crowd sourcing a car for him. DM Blowpop for the Pax name to put in so the funds are directed to the right place.

This is the one that Tenderloin mentioned. It's the House of Hope North Georgia food bank.

The Q prayed as best he could for the requests mentioned.

The site Q thanks for everyone who came out for Ringpop's Bday VQ. Ringpop has been wanting to lead a Q for about a month now. As his father I really appreciate the encouragement and support he gets from F3 to do hard things. There is no better substitute for building real lasting self esteem than accomplishing hard and scary tasks. Your prodding and encouragement is what helps the younger Pax dare to think they can step out into unfamiliar territory. And its that daring to step up that helps them grow into the men we need them to be.

Group can start at whichever yard marker they want, start at "base" or zero yard marker, run to a yard marker, sheet of paper next to each cone with an exercise and a number of reps based on which yard marker you are at followed by a mode of transportation back to your base.

backblasts.title: STUPID SH!T
backblasts.body:
The Catbox has a reputation for hosting some seriously tough beatdowns. Not today! Today I was in the mood to do some STUPID SH!T. We had some fun.
Warmup: Short mosey to the Bball court where we did some SSH, the always popular Weed Pickers, some Sun Gods, Copperhead Merkins, reverse Copperhead Squats, and some wrist shakes.
We moved to the hill for some "Pole Position". The task was to Bear Crawl up to the top of the hill where we alternate between executing 5 Merkins and 5 Squats. Each PAX takes a turn at the pole position where the hill is longest, after returning to the bottom he then sprints to the short end of the hill. The rest of the group then shifts down putting a new PAX on the pole position. We got a good sweat going.
The next element of this STUPID SH!T BD was the "Ben Simmons". On the Bball court each PAX takes 2 free throws while the rest of us hold an air chair, or defensive position (Thanks Ice T). If he misses the shot we execute 5 SSH, if he makes the shot we execute 5 Mike Tysons.  Needless to say we did a lot of SSHs. Although I was surprised at how many brothers could actually shoot, this was really some STUPID SH!T that will probably never be part of any BD I Q again.
Nest was the Bucket Train where we split into two groups and each formed a line. The PAX in the front passes a bucket of sand to the PAX behind him by twisting to the right. When the bucket reaches the PAX at the end of the line he Rifle Carries the bucket to the front and starts the process over by passing the bucket to the left. The next time the bucket was passed over the head. The lines slowly moved forward across the field. A healthy competitive spirit between the two groups kept us moving at a good pace. Not a bad exercise but next time I will make the buckets heavier… just for Rug Burn. We did return for a 2nd round of the Bucket Train after we did some Gronks.
What are Gronks you ask? It's where we divide into 2 groups, quarterbacks and receivers. On "HIKE" the receiver ran a 10-yd down and in rout, then the QB throws him a pass. If the PAX catches the pass we executed 5 Squat Jumps, if he missed it was 5 Burpees. Each PAX had three opportunities to throw and catch. Great fun was had, lots of brothers hit the turf. Rachet ran the best routs but unfortunately had the worst QB, I won't mention his name but it rhymes with CrackShaft.
After another run of Bucket Train we moved to 10 minutes of a Mini-Murph. 20 Butt Squats, 10 Pull-Ups, 25 LBCs.
Next, I felt the need….the need for speed. To me nothing beats an all-out sprint. We lined up in two groups about 25 yards apart and one-by-one knocked out sprints. Fleetwood wanted more distance so we opened it up to 35 yards. After 5 sprints each we grabbed all the gear and moved up to the Pavilion for some Weedpickers, Flutterkicks, and Up-Downs.
I learned that most of us can shoot a basketball, but not much better than Ben Simmons. I learned that Tackleberry knows Girl Talk, pretty hip. Most importunely I learned that Dufresne knows all the words to Digital Underground's The Humpty Dance. Impressive. This beatdown confirmed that when Q-ing you can get grown-ass men to do almost anything.
We solidified absolutely nothing regarding plans for July 4th convergence or this Monday. Watch for Slack updates.
We sent prayers to the brothers PB, Sharapova, Ratchet and their families.

back to the Circle of Life

only had time for once around then…

Announcements:  2 Year Anniversary of The Rattlesnake Riviera tomorrow at 0530 with a Pineapple Express Convergence for runners.  Special Guest Q.  Backdraft did us a solid and asked who knew how to do CPR.  Updated us on the current technique and how to check a pulse in three places.  Thank you!  We needed to hear that.
Prayer Requests:  For the National Guard, Police, demonstrators and citizens of Minneapolis this week.  For Deuce2's family in Peachtree.  Ice T's extended family.  Thanks was given.  Prayers were asked.
Naked Man Moleskin:  YHC loves the Circle of Life.  It keeps the PAX close together for Great mumblechatter.  Sometimes too close.  And sometimes too much mumblechatter.  It began early with grumblings of a cluster and not enough lines and circles but subsided quickly with instructions and ignoring.  By the second round there was no more chatter only mumbling and complaining and calls for modification and modifications.  The Suicides was a great change of pace mid-Beatdown.  Pop Up also came up with a new colorful name for the Circle.  If brown is considered a color.  Always great to sweat with my brothers at the Den.  Honored to lead you HIMs this morning.
Brady Bunch only agreed to do a Co-Q if I agreed to do the BackBlast.  Hey, wait a minute…

backblasts.title: What the Foxtrot?
backblasts.body:
INTRO:
It's a closely held secret that YHC got his name from his other hobby, ballroom dancing. So was born the idea of a dance school. The first lesson: The Foxtrot. The Foxtrot is a "traveling" dance meaning you can cover some serious ground on the dance floor or … your local AO.
WARM-O-RAMA: Mosey to the lower lot for a headcount and to practice the F3 introduction.  The PAX did SSH (20), Weed Pickers (15) and Windmills (15), and some copperhead squats, all in cadence.
THE THANG:
Mosey to the bus lanes for an explanation of the workout, an escalator based on the seven letters in Foxtrot. YHC found seven exercises the Exicon that start with those letters and were easy on the shoulders. The letters and counts:
F: Flutter Kicks (10)

O: Overhead Presses (20)

X: X-factors (30)

T: Tennessee Rocking Chairs (40)

R: Rosalitas (50)

O: Outlaws (60) 30 L/30 R

T: Twinkle Toes (70)
The rules are simple, complete the first exercise and run a lap.  Plank/air chair for the six to keep the PAX together after each lap. Add the next exercise to the previous one(s), run a little more.
The mumblechatter: Started early when the PAX pointed out that X-factors and TN Rocking Chairs had local nicknames.  Around the time of those same-said TN Rocking Chairs, some PAX claimed they had no rhythm for dancing, let alone for that particular exercise.
YHC did call an audible along the way changing the count from Kodiak to single and skipping the last lap so everyone could enjoy the Twinkle Toes (calf raises while doing an Al Gore). Everyone passed the foxtrot lesson though and we moseyed back to the Flag for some Mary (Mountain Climbers, copperhead Merkins and Star Jumps).
Circle of Trust:
Fleetwood was 6th man and he shared a powerful teaching that we are vessels and we need to work to empty ourselves to make room for God. He was more eloquent but your get the drift. Prayers both spoken and unspoken were sent to be answered.
Naked Man Moleskin:
I am grateful to the men of The Lions Den for pushing me to get back out in the gloom and to Q this beatdown. Clipboards and whistles were mentioned as aides but if I said if I heard the music I would want to dance, and I did.  I have really missed the 1st F during recovery and thank all the PAX across F3 that have reached out to me. SYITG soon.

backblasts.body:
I wanted to change up routines and introed a new one to give the guys muscle confusion and variety. I think that’s one of the coolest things abou the first F — your muscles never know what’s coming and you work parts you didn’t know you had! That can only make us strong (Hence the Kayne song in the playlist.)
short Mosey to warmups— SSH, WPs (whoo hoo!), Imp Walkers, Merkins, Plank Jacks, and more SSHs. Random numbers of reps.
then to @roscoep’s fave workout — Bear Crawls. 4’s (not 3’s as Roscoe pointed out. Wow, everyone’s a freakin Q in this group except on paper, ha!) Shoulder Taps at the bottom, Bear Crawls up the hill. Three squats at the top. A ‘lil strong o pearls warmup for the main attraction.
Mosey to the school where we did C-19s — five exercises, 19 reps each, with a run in between. the exercises spell out COVID. 1) Chinook squats 2) Outlaws 3) V-Ups 4) Imperial Walker Squats, and 4) Double shot o Jackie plank-jack/SSH combos, basically a Burpy). Hey, continue to keep yourself and your fam safe — distance, wash, wear masks and all the smart stuff, ok?)
Backdraft killed by by nearly running through the list twice. Shout out to Mall Cop (who represented F3 beautifully by finishing 1st in age group at Guns and Hoses run this week!!!! Props!!!!) Roscoe P also got angry at COVID and is probably now immune.
Seriously, we’re grateful those who had it are recovering and those who are still struggling — hanging there. Our hearts go out to those who know people who didn’t make it or are still hurting from it. It’s some serious nasty shit!

backblasts.body:
This was F3 weather. 30 something degrees and rainy. It's better in the rain. It's always better in the rain. Cold rain is better still. A little more wind and it would be epic, but you get what you get.
It was YHC's honor to execute a beatdown designed by one of the HIMiest HIMs around, Hombre. Hombre is counted among the number present as he was there in spirit. (Breaking back blast protocol: we love you Dale and will be looking to have you back asap.)
Standard mosey around the parking lot and circled up for a quick disclaimer and warm up.
SSH IC x 23, Weed Pickers IC x10, Windmills IC x10, Cooperhead squats IC x 10, Weed Pickers (encore) IC x 10, Thunder Burpees with resting SSH to Thunderstruck.
The Thang:
Mosey 1 lap around front driveway – Break into two groups – Plank while first PAX does 1 Merkin, second PAX does 2, increasing to 20. Run to flag and back when complete.
Mosey 1 lap around driveway – Ninja 100’s OYO – facing each other – form counts!!
10 burpees, 10 double count mtn climbers, 10 double squat jumps, X3 + 10 burpees
Mosey 1 lap then mosey to parking lanes – Bear Crawl Lunges – bear crawl to first line, lunge back, do a burpee, bear crawl to second, etc. Got to 6 or 7 before time called (typical of PB, had YHC "lapped" a couple times.) Back to the flag for COT.
COT: Hustler and Sweeny Todd decided to switch names in the name-o-rama. A silly little thing but it cracked YHC up. Exactly the goofy kind of stuff that makes F3 fun. Just knuckleheads who like to do hard and dumb stuff together. Charmin was 6th man and said the favorite part of F3 is driving away after a beatdown. Dilly dilly, Charmin.
Announcements: Puddle tomorrow 5:30 at Hartfords, Forever Fed needs helpers.
Prayer: Hombre's family, the people in TX dealing with the aftermath of snowstorm, speedy recovery for Twinkle, continued prayers for T's family dealing with the loss of his MIL.

backblasts.body:

Perform first and second exercise, nur to light pole, 20 BBS's, return. Rinse and repeat, repeating exercises previously performed and adding an exercise to each set, until entire circuit performed on last set. Exercises were:

D –   Diamond David Lee Roth Burpees (5)

A – Alternating Shoulder Taps (15) (2x)

R – Reverse Crunches (20)

K – Knerkins (Chuck Norris Merkins) (25)

S – Squats (30)

I – Imperial Walkers (35) (2x)

D – Derkin N'Diya's (modified to 25)

Naked Man Moleskin: YHC really does not like the 5 a.m. start, but it's nice to be finished at 5:45. It was also good for the soul to work out with PAX YHC rarely sees. The PAX accused YHC of  making up the "Diamond David Lee Roth Burpees." Ha ha, YHC is not that smart – check the Exicon! It actually calls for a scissor kick jump instead of a star jump, but YHC did not want multiple PAX pulling their groins this a.m. Derkin N'Diya's suck. In sum, as OJ put it after the workout, it was odd listening to Pink Floyd and doing something to actually improve our bodies! Ha ha …

backblasts.title: Going Rando
backblasts.body:
The Program – Show up with no assigned Q and figure it out. We will do this on every second Saturday of the month. On this morning, Cookies and Cream took the lead.
Warmorama (led by Cookies) – One lap around track. Weed Pickers; SSH's; Copperhead Merkins; Copperhead Squats.
First Q (Cookies): 5 burpees, bear crawl up side walk toward pavilion. Stop at tree and perform 10 flutter kicks (2x). Bear crawl to pavilion. 15 squats. Run back down hill. Rinse and repeat for 3 total sets. Mary on the six.
Second Q (Pie Bar): Head to the cat box. Perform 9's with pull-ups and merkins. After each set run across field to sidewalk and do 10 BBS's. Mary on the six.
Third Q (Callahan): Mosey to Pavilion for "Champion Rounds." Perform prescribed number of each exercise. All PAX stop when first PAX , or "Champion," reaches the number, then run one lap. Sets: 75 Merkins (champion: Rugburn); 80 Dips (champion: Backdraft); 55 BBS (champion: Pie Bar); 25 Burpees (champion: Fleetwood). 4 sets of exercises and laps, total.
COT: Road Runner, Pop Up's 2.0 (who is not in system so not listed above), was six man. He talked with Fleetwood about gutting out the bear crawls with no gloves. Prayers were said.
Highlights: Cookies breaking into a flat out sprint during the mosey lap; Backdraft falling and sliding down the pavilion hill, then doing it on purpose 3 times after that; Road Runner beating everyone on the last lap; everyone designating Fleetwood as the burpee champion before we even started the set, then doing 10 burpees and watching him do 25 (ha ha); the wet, cold suck. Seriously though, this was a great debut for the Randorama concept. YHC believes it's here to stay.

backblasts.title: Worst and Best of 1 Year of F3
backblasts.body:
(Phone ran out of memory after 23 of 25 PAX… )
Thanks Lion’s Den!
After a Covid-possible delay, YHC got to continue his Qing in celebration of his One Year Anniversary of F3 at his first hate, he means Love – The Lion’s Den.  Where that first time, he showed up 2 minutes late and a problematic number of men were already carrying some white cylindrical objects above their heads in circles near the basketball courts.  These objects turned out to be light PVC pipes filled with sand that got heavier and HEAVIER as that first workout went on.  Today we celebrated the BEST and the WORST of short circuit’s first year of F3.
Warm-o-Rama:  Side Straddle Hops, Weed pickers, Windmills, Little Baby Arm Circles, Arch Worm Merkins
Count off, 24, …Dump Truck, 25.  PAX find the partner where your numbers add up to 25. ???  Confusion sets in.  Let’s mosey, down to the bottom of the Freedom Hill.
The Thang:  YHC has hated Freedom Hill.  (But it’s made him stronger.) (And he still hates it.)  So we’re using it.  YHC also hates burpees.  So we’re doing them.  But one of the best things about F3 to YHC is Picking up the 6.  It’s a key ingredient to “any fitness level” and the push and encouragement we need to get better.  It gives the fastest/strongest of guys and the slowest/not yet strongest of guys a little something extra when it occurs.
Goodyear BLIMP(S), partner cumulative
50 Burpees
75 Lunges (Bonnie Blairs)
100 Imperial Walkers
125 Merkins
150 Plank Jacks
200 Squats
Oh, and EMOM everybody yell BURPEE! and wherever you are, drop and do 3.
Pick up the 6 when partners finish.
Back to the flag with 2 minutes of Mary and way too many LBCs for time.
YHC did the count off to make himself 6th man to share a few anniversary words.  Weight is down, cholesterol is down, resting heart is way down, kidney functions are up.  For a guy that HATES to run, a 5k and 10k are both under his belt at 7 and 11 months, respectively.  YHC has 400 new friends and brothers that have gone out of their way to help one another in the ups and downs and everyday tasks of life.
NMM:  Very thankful for the Lion’s Den and the Lions of the Den.  YHC still looks back and can’t believe 300+ guys were working out in Cherokee before the crack of dawn, rain or shine, heat or chill (??) while YHC stayed up too late and “slept in”.  Who knew YHC could get more done by 9am with F3 than all day without it.  YHC is stronger physically, mentally, emotionally and spiritually thanks to the PAX of F3 Cherokee.  Thank you for getting after it even before short circuit was a thing.  It was a "Goodyear"!

backblasts.title: Millennials
backblasts.body:
Light rain. Light attendance, mostly because of the 2am tornado siren waking everyone up. Props to those who made it despite the early wakeup call.
Temps in the 50s-60s. Short Mosey. Warm-up with Chops helping Hustler get the disclaimer right (my second Q). Weedpickers, Imperial Walkers, apparently with a bad cadence (maybe Mall Cop can teach me the right way someday!) SSH and others. Then Mosey to location where board with instructions for Millennials was posted. This exercise is great because I think it challenges the veteran studs, yet also encourages the slower dudes to keep up in support of the group, and everyone is working together. See Millenial details in the Exicon, but suffice to say, at the end, the PAX should get 1,000 reps of 10 different exercises in. INTENSE!!!!! We didn't get all the way to the end because we ran out of time. I almost, almost splashed Merlot. And, we ended up running 2.5 miles via Google Earth. A great way to start a gloomy Tuesday.
So you know, Pie Bar doesn't bounce. Odd Job doesn't like Burpees. Mall Cop is very cadence sensitive.
Oddjob, thanks for the coffee!!!
I freaking love Qing. Let me know whenever you need a sub. The Men of the Den are badass and inspiring. It was an honor to lead ya today.

backblasts.title: VQ's Reign
backblasts.body:
This was my VQ. Man, I caught hell for starting the Mosey 1 minute early (and then forgetting the Warms Ups). Thankfully there were 12 outspoken guys there to loudly remind me. They don't miss a thing! Not a shy one in the bunch. Weedpickers, Imperial Walkers, Merkins, Plankjacks and Side Straddle Hops warmed us up. Then 11's — Merkins at the bottom of the hill and SSHs at the top. Mumblechatter was at a minimum during the 11's. Planked and Dealer's Choice while waiting on the 6. Never seen a hands-free plank before, and guess I never will! Then we Mosied to hear an excellent, thoughtful playlist and do BLIMPS (5 Burpees, Lap, 10 Lunges, Lap, 15 IWs, Lap, 20 Merkins, lap, 25 Plankjacks Lap to 30 Squats. This was in honor of one of F3 Cherokee founders, @babyface, who did a visiting Q a few weeks ago at Lion's Den and introduced me to BLIMPS. Some guys ran an even longer lap route — impressive and inspiring. A few PAX, Backdraft and Mall Cop among them, completed at least one BLIMP before time was up.
Backdraft was 6th Man in COT, and told us to remember to put our families first before all here on Earth. In my Q talk, I reminded all to look for others who need help because God has made us strong, confident and capable for a reason (not just to admire our cut frames in the bathroom mirror! You'll get there Swap. Keep running.) We prayed for McDreamy's boy (Tyler), Ice T and family, Backdraft for strength to face challenges and in general for all to have gratitude to God for all his gifts, his love and his mercy.
Lion's Den PAX'er have a decision to make: Backdraft has the Q at CatBox Saturday (6:30am, I think), and Swap has it at Woodshed at 7am. Hmmmm. I wonder which will be tougher? The drive to Hobgood might be worth it. Lots of Weedpickers, very few Burpees, maybe?
Have a strong day men!!!!

backblasts.title: Super 11’s
backblasts.body:
Start with a mosey to “the black hole” (a.k.a. Basketball Courts).
Side straddle hops / weed picker (hooray) / sun gods / Mike Phelps / copper headed merkins / copper headed squats
“Merkicide” to start.  Foul line & back, half court & back, foul line & back, full court & back.  5 merkins at each stop.
The intro of Super 11’s to the cat box!!!!
6 cones spread out evenly along both side lines of a basketball court (12 total).  Each 2 sets of cones across from each other its own set of “11”.
First cone start with 1 – Squat Pulse + Squat Jump…run across court to 2nd cone
Second cone across is laying on your side single arm tricep Ext – 10 each arm…back across court diagonally to the 3rd cone
3rd cone – j-lo’s (4 count) – 1 rep
4th – single leg calf hops (4 count) – 10 reps
5th – Bonnie Blair’s (2 count) – 1 reps
6th – burpees – 10 reps
7th – hand release merkins – 1 rep
8th – big boy sit-ups – 10 reps
9th – Mike Tyson’s – 1 rep
10th – plank jacks (4 count) – 10 reps
11th – Peter Parker (2 count) – 1 rep
12th – Mountain Climbers (4 count) – 10 reps
Return back to the first cone and the 1 rep exercises become 2 reps and the 10 rep exercises from round 1 become 9 reps.  Always adding up to 11.
other notes:
I learned a harsh lesson by starting out the Super 11’s by saying, “I’m not sure anyone’s done this before”… a classic Cat Box joke followed.

I underestimated just how black the black hole as it was difficult to read the work out sheets that I had made at each cone.

Also underestimated how much shoulder work we were getting and how difficult it was just getting up and down from each station.
Pie Bar and Backdraft finished right on time.  Nice work dudes.  Work on better form next time (wink wink).

My apologies for the music issues…looks like I need a new speaker from Santa this year.

Great words from Roscoe P in the COT about the every day battle men face and looking to faith for that guidance to win those battles.

Prayers for all of those in, and outside of F3, effected by Covid.

Prayers for Hillary and Amy.
The Cat Box continues to be a tough BD week in and week out.  This time I can only blame myself (ha).  The effort is infectious and the fellowship is just as strong.  I appreciate all of you.  Please no burpees at The Lion’s Den this week.  Thank you.

backblasts.title: Full Body Tabata
backblasts.body:
YHC was suppose to Q on Thursday, but with an available slot on Tuesday why wait.  You can always expect big numbers at TLD so needed to make sure we got in some big reps as well.  Farm Country said that he was bringing someone so make sure the workout doesn't suck.  5:30 comes quick, but not quick enough in this cold.  Quick mosey straight to the coupon stack, picking one up along the way as we made our way to the basketball court for a quick warm up.  2 FNGs so disclaimer was made with some Ice-T reminders along the way (thanks for keeping me honest).  SSHs, Weedpickers, Sungods, Michael Phelps and some good, slow copperhead merkins on the coupon was enough warm up.  We needed all the time we had.  Time for some full body Tabata.
Quick mosey to the board with coupon.  We had 9 exercises to perform for one minute each and 25 seconds of "rest".  PAX was good until explanation that the rest was a sprint to the cones and back to coupon before next set (why waste time resting is Tabatas motto).  Exercises were all performed with coupon and included:
Coupon Swing
Alternating Merkins on Coupon
Goblet Squats
LBCs
Overhead Straddle Hops
Thrusters
Big Boy Situps
Reverse Lunges
Man Makers
PAX were strong going through the first round and the sprints kept everyone "warm".  At the end why stop there, so we rinse and repeated to everyone's dismay.  Attacking the second round, YHC decided to move cones a little closer so that some rest was given between the sets (thanks MallCop for the help).  Got through 2 rounds before we had to put the coupons back and mosey back to the flag.  Just in time for some quick Mary.  Callout to BlackHawk who wanted flutter kicks (in cadence of  course), Farm Country who likes American Hammers and Roscoe P who hit some quick LBCs.  Time called, good job.
COT with MallCop as 6th Man.  Showed the FNGs how to do it and then sprinted off into the night (looks like somebody is a runner).  First FNG was Cookies 'N Cream because that was his favorite ice cream (thanks OddJob).  Second FNG was Superfly due to watching wrestling (although Superfly may have been before his time).  Mention of the upcoming half marathon at Wartowne and ended with prayer for all.  Short Circuit reminded me to write a backblast so even though a few days late it's completed.  Until next time.

backblasts.title: We belong together
backblasts.body:
One year together… ish. YHC will really celebrate 1 year on Saturday the 14th… but close enough.
Warm-O-Rama: Mosey down the hill loop, up the street between the schools and back around. mixed it up a little from the typical loop
side straddle hops, weed pickers (not enough. got way too many grumbles), Blarts, copperhead merkins and we were off.
The Thang: I wanted to pay homage to some of the best/worst workouts I have experienced in the last year. I set up five stations with a map similar to something Pie Bar had done. Lots of trash talk about my map. "is it to scale?" Yes, yes it is. "did you run out of ink?" "are we on COVID ink rations" "where is this supposed to be?" Clearly the PAX can't see at 0530 and they can't read maps either. I printed a legitimate map of the schools and added location tags.
STATION 1 in front of Freedom: 25 chicken peckers, lap around the circle, dragon walk down and back up a bus lane, lap, 50 Carolina dry docks, lap, 15 workins, lap
STATION 2 Liberty bus lanes: partner up. Partner 1 begins running around the circle while Partner 2 does 25 curls for the girls. WITH COUPON (they hated me for this) run and catch Partner 1. Swap, rinse/repeat until 250 cumulative curls.
STATION 3 Liberty parking lot: I brought an old school boom box. Paid for 6 C batteries and everything. I had relearned how to burn a CD and made a copy of Thunderstruck. For this we would side straddle hop the entire song and perform 1 burpee each time Thunder/Thunderstruck was sung. 33 burpees were performed. 33. that's not so bad…
STATION 4 Freedom sign: Starting at the bottom of the hill, Bernie Sanders to the top. perform 25 squats and jog back. rinse/repeat until the ENTIRE ThunderBurpee group has arrived to relieve you from the pain.
STATION 5 Freedom basketball courts: Four Corners. Start in one corner. Perform 20 reps each of American hammers, crunchy frogs, flutter kicks (Kodiak count) and Rosalitas. Rotate clockwise. Bear crawl on short legs and lung on the long legs. Repeat exercises but 30 reps, next corner 40, final corner 50.

We ended with COT praying for PAX going thru hard times and illnesses.
I truly enjoyed this beatdown. It brought great joy to see how many middle fingers and "I hate you!" I was able to capture today. I was worried this would have been a really easy beatdown, but it proved that it could stand true to the needs of the Den. Already planning my second anniversary beatdown…

YHC knew that he couldn't waste the PAX's time at CatBox so the BD had to deliver. Criteria was pull-ups, sand and volume. What better way to start than with a "quick" mosey. Typical moseys are usually short to warm up, but knowing this group was ready to go we went ahead with a 1/2 mile mosey around the pool and back to the flag.
Circle up for SSHs, Weedpickers, Sungods, Michael Phelps and come quick copperhead merkins and squats. Then time to get to it.
Head on over to the playset for a bit of Tabata between pull-ups and swerkins. Half start on pull-ups and other half on swerkins. 40 sec work and 20 sec rest (rest defined as getting back to the other station). Setup some alternative grips for inverted rows as well to hit different parts of the back. PAX was strong with the mumble chatter being the only thing stronger. Was told a few times "I hate you" which is the sincerest form of flattery. Audible called after a few rounds so that we would finish up in the volleyball pit.
Escalator de Dora happened in a big way at sandbox with some coupons for added pleasure. Dora consisted of

100 BBS

200 Thrusters

300 Flutter Kicks (Single Count)

400 Air Presses

500 SSHs

For the 100, 200 and 300 reps mode of transportation was bear crawl/crawl bear with coupon in the sandbox and flap jack.

For the 400 and 500 reps mode of transportation was coupon lunges.
Extra credit was an AMRAP of 25 coupon curls while partner did reverse grip merkins, but noone made it.
Time ran out so put back coupon and end with name-o-rama, 6th man (Soup which I cannot find in the PAX names), naming of FNG Callahan (working in logistics and Tommy Boy, it just made sense) and COT (A thank you to Ice T for leading prayer).

backblasts.body:

The PAX assembled under a bright full moon for a haunted Halloween beat down. And YHC decided to dust off the old Teen Wolf costume, so it was time for a basketball-inspired  workout.

Sequence Drill: Multiple sets of running baseline to baseline with escalating number of reps. Perform 10 merkins at the end of each set. Sets were: 1 length, 3, 5, 7, 9, 7, 5, 5, 3, and 1. Mumblechatter decreased significantly by first set of 5 lengths.

YHC's son, Bugs, was in attendance. We also welcomed: Squirrel, Turbo, Wiley, Dirty Bird, Sonic, and Purple Haze. Special thanks to the PAX who stayed and helped with the obstacle course even though their 2.0's were not present.
