backblasts.title: INVERSION THERAPY
backblasts.body:
"…Because I was inverted."   Maverick – "Top Gun"
YHC planned something special for the PAX today.  Coming off the previous month of IronPAX grinders YHC felt it important to promote growth within the group by pushing outside our agility comfort zone.  Enter today's BD: Inversion Therapy.
Warm O' Rama
Mosey two laps around the bus lanes following the yellow cones setup in observance of Ellie's Day.  Circle up in the field close to the school.  YHC kicked off the beats via Ice T's (thanks T!) kick-a$$ flare speakers.  PAX were informed of Saget's previous Dj'ing (skillz?) to much laughter and name calling.  Gotta keep it light!  Sun Gods, Phelps and Frankensteins followed.    Time for a new exercise – Sampson's in to Spider-Mans…these hit the PSOAS (the what???)…it's the muscle that runs from your back around to your core…causes lots of back issues…hit it well!  Inch Worms and Wrist Stretch next.  Special shout out to Chops for helping YHC minimize the train-wreck of instructions…Commander-of-all-Compliance!  Recover!
The Thang
Inversion Skillz Work
Mosey to the wall.  Partner up and practice Hand Stand Kick Ups for 5 minutes.  Partner 1 helps Partner 2 kick up on to the wall, if needed.  YHC was impressed with the group on these.  Most of us men over 20 who are not gymnasts hear our brains say "oh hell no!" when presented with a movement like this.  Everyone worked to overcome those thoughts and get up on that wall…way to believe in yourself!
At the 5 minute mark we switched to practice Ballz to the Wall / Wall Walks.  Partner helped spot PAX, if needed.  Again, great work all around working to get as high as possible on the wall.  PAX can show their M's and 2.0's that they now can pirouette…Fabulous!
AMRAP
Now on to the fun.  19 minute AMRAP consisting of the following:
1 Lap
30 HRR Merkins
1 Lap
30 Big Boy Situps
1 Lap
3 B2W/Wall Walk

PAX KILLED IT!  Lots of grunting and groaning on those HRRs and B2W.  Chalk board was used to mark each round that PAX completed…38 rounds were accomplished, in total.  Great work!
COT
Picture of the group was taken (thanks Drone!), Count off, Name O' Rama
6th Man: Tackleberry, thank you for sharing!
Announcements: Saturday, Nov. 28th all day Q at Veteran's Park…sign up!  Don't forget about F3 service opportunities this month!  Get out there and share the love.  JackBauer is collecting the list.
Prayer: Prayers for Chop's work opportunity, go get em'!  Prayers for Twinkle Toe's shoulder injury, we pray for recovery.  Remember Ellie's Day…Be Kind to One Another!
Coffeteria: so good Ice T, thanks!
SYITG

Murder bunnies back. Murder bunnies back (again) – 50 squat thrusters. Murder bunnies back. Murder bunnies back (again) – 25 squat thrusters. Murder bunnies back. Sprint to play ground – 25 pull ups, sprint back to kitty box.
Bear crawl across 3 volleyball courts dragging coupon. – 75 kettle bell swings. Leave coupon and lunge back. Bear crawl to coupon for 50 kettle bell swings, lunge back. Bear crawl to couple for 25 kettle bell swings, lunge back. Sprint to Pavilion for 50 merkins. Pick up the 6.
Frankly, YHC never made it out of murder bunny row before time expired. In all likelihood, only @PB and @RugBurn finished. It was all kinda blurry.
YHC did recall seeing @Ratchet running laps while the rest went back to the flag for the COT. About the time the COT ended @Ratchet comes in and knocks out 20 burpees. The extra work may or may not have been in payment for low score in FF. Strong work!
Stuff was said in the COT and it will stay there.  YHC will end how this began; it is an honor to Q.

backblasts.title: WOD of Oz
backblasts.body:
Intro:

YHC had been planning to get back to post at the Oz and when the Q was open saw a good time to do that. (Did not plan for @Vespa to be gone that day but for some reason the Oz PAX initially were more happy to see me at the Q then him. Not sure why, (maybe his bear crawling up steep hill BD’s have something to do with this..) In any event, they were smiling until YHC unveiled the WOD of Oz planned. (Basically it was an Adjusted Bert WOD with more running..)
Warm-O-Rama:

Mosey out of the church exit up to the main road back down on the other side entrance around the back of the church and circle up near the “impossible to steal or lose” flag location: SSH, (Side Straddle Hop); TWP’s, (The Weed Pickers); IP’s (Imperial Walkers); MP’s, (Michael Phelps); & SG’s, (Sun Gods)
The Thang:

WOD of Oz (Adjusted Bert)
40 Burpees

660 meter Run

80 Merkins

660 meter Run

120 Walking Lunges

660 meter Run

160 Air Squats

660 meter Run

120 Walking Lunges

660 meter Run

80 Merkins

660 meter Run

40 Burpees
*Plan was If one round got completed, bear crawls were on the menu with a rinse and repeat directive after that. More about the “If” below.
COT:

Thanks we are able to come out and get fit together like we did today, others are not so fortunate. Prayers for DumpTruck’s M’s grandfather in a tough situation in hospice. Collective Prayers for attending PAX’s families, including Tenderloins’ growing family with a new 2.0 due in Feb! Also, prayers for those prayers not mentioned.
NMM:

Snap On informs YHC early on that he had been out for 3 weeks for a running injury right before we go to run for the warm-up and before YHC gets to point out we will get about 2.5 miles of running in between reps.. (Woops, "modify as needed"… ) Despite this, he did great and kept a swift pace through the whole BD! WOD of Oz had nothing to do with the Wizard of Oz and everything to do with the AO name and YHC's intent to plagiarize some WOD out there for the BD, ;). YHC stole The Bert, but modified it due to the run distance we had to work with at the Oz, (660 meters, versus 400 meters for The Bert) and also because YHC thought starting the BD with 50 burpees would have been mean, we only started with 40. YHC adjusted the other reps down too. (It is a good thing that adjustment was made…)

As we wrapped up the WarmOramas and YHC was PAXplaining the WOD to the PAX and referencing YHC's "illuminated white board", Dump Truck came driving in "early" at about 5:09am. Got him up to speed and he jumped right into the burpees with a smile, (what looked like a smile) with the rest of us.
YHC thinks this was the point that Tenderloin let YHC know that a 10 rep modification was not that much of a modification from 50-40… While he complained, YHC has no idea why as despite being half awake from camping with his 2.0 over the weekend and watching horrible Sunday night football, he killed the WOD of Oz this morning!
The PAX kept attacking the reps. The running path and the walking lunges path also had an overlay route which allowed the PAX to hear each other cursing YHC as some ran while others did their walking lunges. *YHC likely cursed the most though, (240 walking lunges is a lot…) Tenderloin was polite and waited to curse YHC about those on Slack later in the morning..

As we were coming down the other side of the round of the WOD of Oz, Snap On mentions that he hears YHC's slot machine timer ringing which informs YHC that we will not even make it through a full round.. 660 meter runs takes longer then YHC thought.. It is also about this time that Ratchet tells me that he comes to the Oz BD on his lunch break, (at 5am in the morning! Guy is working hard and still getting his fitness in!) and he says he needs to leave right at 5:45am and has to head to his car. So… YHC let the PAX know we need to wrap up reps and we looped to pick up the 5th, (we only had 5 today so yes, “the 5th”). Time did not let us get to the second round of Merkins or Burpees, (there were only 40 burpees left..) but I would still say it was still a BD. We then met for the COT near the “impossible to steal or lose” flag location. Did the COT thing, YHC passed out some warm and cold water, (Dump Truck wanted the warm water for some reason..(?)) and we then caught up on IronPAX stories. Also had discussions about AO locations, PAX posting numbers and what motivated people to post, & preferred starting times of AO’s. It all wrapped up for me with Dump Truck sharing pictures of what his PE students believe are triangles with more than 3 sides which represent their emotional and physical health. 🙁 Great welcome back to OZ! Love these guys and the time here! Will have to get back when @Vespa is not hanging out in LA next time..

Then run back to home base and do 25 BBS's, and so on and so on. As there are different locations where different exercises could be performed, PAX could choose how far to run for certain exercises. 20 pull-ups
20 burpee block jumps
20 coupon thrusters
30 dips
40 merkins (these had to be performed in front of Liberty so as to add some running distance)
balls to the wall (AYG)
40 coupon squats
40 alpo's w/ coupon
The gazelle group finished at about 6:11, so YHC called for the PAX to perform railroad tracks. We started with 4, then other PAX joined as they finished. We went the length of the upper lot, then called it a day. This provided just enough extra suck as we were laying on the cold wet pavement.
Notes:
Drone was present today – this page will not allow me to input his name. He got a sweet video of our inch worming
Saget began the workout in a full rain suit. Then he peeled his pants off to reveal jogging shorts, which were a bit, um, short. Seriously, they made me uncomfortable
Same goes for our FNG (Sweeney Todd)
Couldn't tell if I was sweating or not because of the torrent of rain – but I think I got a good sweat in
A moat formed to protect the pile of coupons which had to be navigated by the PAX. This was a good added obstacle
Chops and Sparkles kept moving the entire BD even though they were hurting a bit from the running. Great job!
YHC hates Balls to the Wall
It was great to see Twinkle Toes back in action today!
YHC loves the Den!

backblasts.title: Cat Blox
backblasts.body:
Having Q'd twice already this week, YHC was pretty sore rolling out of the fart sack this morning. But this is Cat Box day – so no time to fool around.
Warm-o-rama: Get blocks out of truck. Drop them off in cat box. Mosey across field and back to middle. SSH's; Seal Jacks; Mummy Kicks; Weed Pickers; Sun Gods/Michael Phelps; Merkins; Squats
The Thang: Mosey back to Cat Box. Perform escalating circuit of exercises (mostly with a coupon), i.e., first circuit is first exercise; second circuit is first and second exercise; third circuit is first, second, and third exercise, and so on and so on (you get the idea) until you end with one complete circuit at end. Between each round, run to other side of field and complete 25 BBS's, run back. Circuits/exercises were as follows:
– 5 Pull-Ups

– 10 Burpee Block Jumps

– 15 Bench Dips

– 20 Thrusters

– 25 Merkins

– 30 Shoulder Press

– 35 Coupon Swings

– 40 Lunges w/Coupon

– 45 Standing Tricep Extensions (or French Press)

– 50 Curls for Girls
There was a lot of grumbling when YHC explained the routine this morning. Someone (Blackhawk) said we'd only finish half the routine. Well, most of the PAX made it to the final round – though no one finished. Many PAX noted in the COT that we would never do a routine like that on our own – we push each other, and that's the F3 difference!
The Cat Box – where sh*t gets done!

backblasts.title: The Brother's Beatdown
backblasts.body:
This beatdown was dedicated to the brothers we've all found as members of F3.
Warmup. Short mosey, the usual; SSH, Weed-Pickers, Sun Gods, Merkins, and a single Imperial Walker (because it's a stupid exercise).
Each section of the beatdown was preceded by a trivia question that was "brother" themed. The brothers that were featured were the Wrights (flight), the Mannings (NFL), the Youngs (AC/DC), the James (Outlaws).
After we "brothered" up we split into two groups and attacked two stations.
Station 1: Bucket Brigade – A bucket of sand attached to a rope that was slung over an 8′ bar. 
Brother 1 runs a lap while brother 2 does pulldowns or seated rows, then they switch. Continue rotation for 12 minutes.
Station 2: Sucktime
Brother 1 does bear crawl for 40 yards, crawl bear back, execute 25 LBCs. Continue for 6 minutes then switch with brother 2.
Brother 2 does 10 pull-ups, then 25 squats. Continue for 6 minutes then switch with brother 1.
After 12 minutes the groups switched stations.
Station 3: Sprints x5

backblasts.title: The Nine Circles of H-E-Double Hockey Sticks
backblasts.body:
Circles, Circles, Circles was the name of the game today at The Catbox. The PAX enjoyed nine circles of fun (pain) to be exact. YHC, the Q, wanted to raise the intensity today and the PAX brought it 110%!
Circle one involved the traditional "Mosey" around the cat field…two laps was in order.
Circle two was Warm O' Rama time including "do it yourself" Sungods and Phelps, Frankensteins (or Mummies), Merkins and a sit in to a deep squat where many moans and groans were presented as notes of approval. Q added in Side-Straddle-Hops because PAX have an addiction to them and Weedpickers.
Circle thee was where the real fun began: Bataan Death March with Burpees was this circle for the PAX. Q split the line in two once he realized there was too much mosey'n and not enough hard work.
Circle four was an interesting little diddy: PAX got in a circle and performed coupon squats in sync with the song "Sally Up, Sally Down" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=51_2XMbwxqo). This one was all about tuning out the pain game. Q suggested finding one's "pain cave"…the PAX who wondered what that meant may now have a better understanding after completing this circle.
Circles five through eight were a variation on a Tabata routine with some modifications made in order to conserve time for Circle nine. Three tabata's were performed: Coupon Swings, Hollow Rocks and Coupon Push-Presses. PAX did an awesome job of giving max effort in each tabata.
Finally, circle nine, DEATH BY BURPEES. This one pushed every PAX to his limit and was a perfect way to end the BD. Every minute on the minute PAX performed burpees starting with five the first minute. Every subsequent minute the burpee count was increased by one…except for minute two when the Q decided the PAX were awesome so the count was increased by two. PAX who failed to make the count of burpees in the current minute switched to Merkins until the last HIM was standing. It was PieBar who won the day by completing sets of 5,7,8,9,10,11,12,13,14,15 and 16 burpees. Congrats to PieBar…that was quite a showing!
The morning wrapped up with a super-speedy clean up, the circle of trust, 6th man, the introduction of two new FNGs (welcome! Backdraft and Cargo), an offering of prayer (thanks God!) and coffeeteria.
Great work Men!

YHC had posted a list of coupon related exercises on a poster, and planted next to the bucket of softballs. Instructions.. each team retrieves a ball, PAX 1 throws ball down bus lane as far as possible, while PAX 2 runs to retrieve ball, PAX 1 does reps of exercise with cinder block. Swap with PAX 2, then progress thru exercises. Also 33lb plate is to be retrieved by 1st team then placed in front of any other team to slow/restrictor their retrieval.
List of exercises: Curl, Overhead Press, Elf on Shelf, Bench Press, Squat (chest hold), Pull Over, Man Maker Merkin, Squat (goblet style), Block Swings, Shrugs (R-Down, L-Back), Stiff Dead Leg Lift, Coupon Burpee.
Much dodging of balls, and kicking of balls, and passing around the 33lb plate. Time draws to a close so YHC calls for return of balls to bucket, return of cinder blocks to pile (in similar inch forward fashion), and mozy back toward flag. Call for a stop at bottom of incline to Bernie backward up the parking lot incline. Upon reaching top call for a 21. Ma Deuce has trouble so we 5 burpee penalty, 21 again (where YHC feels it in legs), and after 2nd inability to clean up the conclusion YHC just gets everyone to head back to the flag in defeat.

Always a good turnout at Lions Den. Special place, special people, special bonds.

backblasts.title: 22-Q Operation Fun with Flatline
backblasts.body:
Operation Fun with Flatline kicked off with a mosey around the parking lot and over to the bus lanes of FMS.
Warm-O-Rama: SSH, Cherry pickers, LBCs, Sun Gods, Michael Phelps
Operation Fun with Flatline: Focusing on the average rate of 22 veterans a day that were taking their own lives after coming back from a war zone and dealing with PTSD. Luckily the numbers have decreased some since the study in 2012. Now on to the fun part of this. In remembrance of my 22 years of active military service and some of the AOs that I have been deployed to, I decided to have exercises that started with the first letter of some of my deployment sites.
Guam = 22 single count Groiners with shoulder taps; Crete = 22 Curb Alperts; Spain = 22 Smurf Jacks; Turkey = 22 Travolta Merkins; Egypt = El Capitan down and up a line in a bus lane; Japan = 22 Jumping Spiders; Romania = 22 Rockette Hillbilies; Bulgaria = 22 Burpos; Afghanistan = Apple Turnover down and up the line in a bus lane (Bear Crawl switching to a Crab Crawl). Running a lap around the parking lot after each exercise. The running simulated the flying around the world to each deployment site. With 4 mins to go, we circled up to finish out with Monkey Humpers and American Hammers.  Way to go F3 brothers! Great Job!
COT: 6th man was Mall Cop who shared some information about himself. We welcomed Ma Deuce (formerly known as FNG). Prayer request for Ice T's mother in-law and thankful prayer for the good results on his 2.0. Prayer request for Dump Truck's M's granddad and grandma as they deal with sickness and separation due to hospital stays. Closed with a prayer. Then it was coffee time (Thanks Ice T).

backblasts.title: Recipe for Pain: Main Ingredient S.P.A.M.S
backblasts.body:
INTRODUCTION:
Over the weekend YHC found a beatdown called S.P.A.M.S on the F3 Memphis site. It's a Monty Python themed variation of B.O.M.B.S.  Change some of the ingredients and up the quantities a bit and you have the recipe for a workout that's fit for the PAX at the Den.  The fact that this week's pre-blast was Python themed was a nice bonus.
WARM-O-RAMA:
Mosey to the lower lot where YHC for the F3 Introduction, disclaimer and the following:
SSH (IC)
Weedpicker (IC)
Imperial Walker (IC)
THE THANG:
Mosey to the bus lanes where YHC explained the Thang.  PAX partner up for encouragement. Each PAX performs the exercises in order, stopping after 25 reps to do a "Silly Walk" out and back in their bus lane.  The type of walk is indicated in the parentheses.
100 – S – SSH (Duck Walk)
125 – P – Plank Jacks (Lunge Walk)
150 – A – American Hammers (High Knees)
175 – M – Merkins (Sideways Bear Crawl)*
200 – Squats (Run short lap)*
The PAX got right to the job and made quick work of the S, P, and the A. Along the way several men found some bang snaps leftover from a 4th of July celebration and used them to encourage the PAX around them.  YHC changed the recipe as needed and called some audibles. The first, reducing the number of Merkins to 150 due to time, the second due to increased mubblechatter about combining Merkins and Sideways Bear Crawls.  * The Bear Crawls and The Short lap were replaced with sprints out and back in the bus lanes.  With 15 seconds left we moseyed back to the flag.
COT:
Welcome FNGs Paparazzi and SueEllen.  Thanks Hurley for making the trip down to the Den. We asked the Sky Q for prayers of the family of Fleetwood's work friend that recently passed away, for Squirtle's friend who has lost his way, for Ice T's mother-in-law and for Chops' 2.0.
NAKED MAN MOLESKIN:

It's always a pleasure being out in the gloom with the Lions Den PAX. Hard working with a great sense of humor.

backblasts.title: Death By Bear Crawl
backblasts.body:
We enjoyed the hill so much last week that we decided to do it again.  Mosey .5 mile to the hill.
Partner Routine: Bridge Over Nest.
Partner 1 would begin bear crawling up the hill (250 meters inclined all the way to the top) while partner one did 10 Merkins, 10 Squats, 10 LBC's and then ran up to the top of said hill and back to their partner, at which time Partner 2 would start with their set of 10s and Partner one would take over the Bear Crawl.
It took two turns of each for both Partners to reach the top.  That was round 1.
Second round, pretty much the same thing, except the running had to run to the top of the hill, and then all the way back down to the bottom and then back up to meet their partner before taking over. Brutal.
Mosey .5 mile back to the flag.

backblasts.title: The Waffle House of Pain
backblasts.body:
The Pax showed up and did some stuff…
Wait, what!?  No!  There is waaay more to it than that!  On a lovely cool(er) than normal June Saturday, the PAX showed up and kicked some butt in the "The Waffle House of Pain".  After a Warm O' Rama involving stretches, Saget Yoga? and running we got to work.
First up, an EMOM of Pike Merkins and Pistols where some redefined how picnic tables at a park can be utilized to add some shoulder mass.
Then, the big game, the "All Star Special".  Broken in to teams of three (insert lots of math here) the group completed two sessions of 10 and 12 minutes with a 5 min. break in between.  Session 1 movements included coupon thrusters, jumping pullups and 100m runs.  The "twist" of the day was that the winning team of the competition would not be the one with the most reps. but the team who most demolished their score from the first of the two sessions (insert way too much math here).
Session two included bur-pee box step-ups, coupon overhead lunges and 100m runs.  In the end one team emerged victorious, there was some laughter, sweat and tears and I was honored to see Chops run faster than I have ever seen (that dude can haul!).
Great Work Gents!

Exercises are the usual… merkins, squats, lbcs… hillbillies, burpees, imperial walkers… other exercises on each on each corner with transitions being backpeddle, high knees, lunge, sprint. Sprints were fun on the top stretch, and guys pushed it. Second lap we increased the reps to 12, and did a couple 21's with 5 burpee penalty on the 1st (thanks T). Finally time is drawing near, so head back up toward freedom, with call for hold and sprint at top lot final stretch. Plan worked out good, PAX seemed cardioed, and QIC survived. backblasts.title: The Last Kingdom
backblasts.body:
This beatdown was inspired by The Last Kingdom on Netflix. Our voyage began as we entered the black hole (Basketball court). Before boarding our vessels we knocked out some SSH, Weed-pickers, and Wrist stretching. The BD was built into four challenges lasting 13 minutes, each challenge would be more difficult than the last.
NAVIGATION

We divided our forces and headed to opposite corners of the court. We navigated to each corner by alternating forward and reverse lunges. Each corner required a specific exercise.

C1 – 50 SSHs

C2 – 50 LBCs

C3 – 50 Overhead Claps

C4 – 50 Mountain Climbers
CONQUEST

Our ships reached the shores of a mountain… Merkin Mountain. Each warrior locked his shield with another (partnered up) then we attacked. Viking 1 executed burpees until his partner returned. Viking 2 charged up the mountain and executed 15 BBS then Crawl Bear'd back down to relieve his partner. After 13 minutes of this we were ready for battle.
BATTLE

Viking 1 seized a coupon (cinder block) and executed curls for the girls until his partner returned. Viking 2 Crawl Bear'd the length of the Kitty Box (Volleyball Court) and fought through 10 Mike Tysons before Crawl Bearing back to relieve his partner. This was a true test of the toughest viking. It was glorious.
TORTURE

Our Viking brothers were not expecting this final challenge. Each of us had to dig deep and push ourselves, and our brothers.

Viking 1 executed 10 pull-ups and 25 hanging abs (leg lifts) while Viking 2 sprinted across the field and executed 20 Peter Parkers. With hardly any wind left in our sails we fought on. One day we may not be victorious.. but it was not THIS day.
We returned to the great hall and prayed to our god. We spoke of justice and wisdom. A great day indeed.

backblasts.title: Fair Weather For Flying BLIMPS
backblasts.body:
INTRO:
YHC had a beatdown in mind then saw the weather forecast (rain with possible t-storms) and decided the PAX would prefer not to have a lot of exercises involving being on their six. Born was the idea of using Yukon Cornelius' BLIMPS from the Dungeon.
WARM-O-RAMA:
Mosey to the lower lot where YHC practiced the F3 introduction and disclaimer. Then the PAX did SSH, Weed Pickers and Windmills in cadence. Those were followed by Sungods and Michael Phelps OYO. YHC remembered Fleetwood's request for F3 name-o-rama before explaining the Thang and confusing the PAX with talk about splitting the group up.
THE THANG:
Mosey back to the bus lanes where we could still apply social distancing despite the number of PAX. YHC explained the workout, an escalator based on six exercises, adding a "letter" after each lap. The letters and counts:
B: Burpees (10)

L: Lunges (20) each leg

I: Imperial Walkers (30) each leg

M: Merkins* (40)

P: Plank Jacks (50) out+in=one

S: Squats (60)
One lap around the upper lot after completing the first exercise, then plank for the six to keep the PAX together. Add the next letter and another lap, and so on. Alice Cooper's "No More Mister Nice Guy" came on around letter P. Not planned, just a nice bonus. YHC did call an audible on "S" changing lunges and Imperial Walkers to single count. This allowed us to get through the whole workout before calling everyone to return to the flag on the last lap.
*Note to self: It's pronounced "Myrrh-kins". YHC may need to go to Chops' elocution school.
Circle of Trust:
Mall Cop gave an update that Dump Truck's newest addition to the family. Daughter is off the CPAP, eating and things are looking up for her. Chops shared the sad news of the passing of his father's 1st cousin on the heels of his aunt's recent stroke. When it rains it does seem to pour. Prayers for all.
Naked Man Moleskin:
It's been too long since YHC's VQ and it's been on my mind. Even after Exile's Q School today's protocol was out of sequence at times and messy (sorry Criss Cross for treating you like the forgotten child during name-o-rama). There is definitely room for improvement and the best way to achieve that is to step up to Q more often. Thanks to the PAX for the feedback, encouraging words and for coming out to the Den. SYITG soon.

backblasts.title: Stay in Your Lane
backblasts.body:
Lions Den Pax show up in large numbers and today didn't disappoint.  In order to keep pax spread out and avoid two groups YHC decided to use the fabbled Lions Den bus lanes to keep 'em separated.  After mosey and quick warm-o-rama pax partnered up and headed to the bus lanes where Q instructions for each pair awaited.  Each pax had their own lane with a shared set of instructions.  The partner-up directive held no purpose other than to have a pax in the lane next to you for company.
Routine consisted transporting to the end of the lane via alternating bear crawls, lunges, side-lunge-squat, and broad jumps.  At the end of the lane an merkins, burpees, LBC's or crunches awaited.  Once done back to the start of the lane via crawl bears, backward lunges, side-squat-lunge, or broad jumps where another round of merkins, burpees, reverse LBC's or flutter kick was performed.  Two trips down and back and the bus was loaded.  Time to take the kids to school around the Freedom loop.  Four rounds pushed us right till time.
COT included announcement regarding the deck/ramp build Ice-T is coordinating.  On that note, Ice-T is true him when it comes to serving F3 and the community at large.  We are lucky to have him.  Prayers for Dump Truck who will welcome a new addition (Tow Truck? Flat Bed?) to his family next Tuesday.

backblasts.title: 45 minutes of Legs
backblasts.body:
The BackBlast:
Intro:
What better way to make my debut back at the The Lion's Den than by focusing on one single area of the body for 45 minutes. Our legs will be jelly the rest of the day.
Warm-o-Rama:
Moseyed around the parking lot and circled up in front of the bus lanes for:
10x Weed Pickers
10x Copperhead Squats
10x Windmills
10x Imperial Walkers
10x Toy Soldiers
No time to waste, on to the routine
The Thang:
As promised, only the legs were worked and ONLY the legs. We would come to regret this. PAX performed the following:
50x Calf Raises
50x Bonnie Blairs
50x Lunges (Kodiak Count)
50x Squats
50x Monkey Humpers
We all took a lap around the parking lot and then did:
50x Calf Raises
40x Bonnie Blairs
40x Lunges (Kodiak Count)
40x Squats
40x Monkey Humpers
We all took a lap around the parking lot.
You can see where this is going. We continued until we completed the last round of 10’s. We had just enough time for 1.5 minutes of Mary where Gecko and Swap has us on our 6 for some core work. I wonder why…
COT:

backblasts.title: The Colonel Beat Down
backblasts.body:
Quick Intro to The Cat Box
Count off into 4 groups.  Mosey to first station.  Quick warm-a-rama.  Start first station at 6:35.  All stations ended at the 5 minute mark (6:45/6:55/7:05/7:15/7:25).

Stations are Dora Style, Goals are all cumulative, Once goals are met, Mary and/or pick up the 6
Group 1 :  Merkin Mountain
Partner 1 – Bottom of Hill = Merkins *Goal 200 Cumulative
Partner 2 Run up hill / 5 plank destroyers / Crawl Bear Down

Group 2:  Basketball Courts
Partner 1 Baseline = Big Boy Situps *Goal 250 Cumulative
Partner 2 Suicide Sprint w/ 10 side straddle hops at the half court and full court lines

Group 3:  Pavilion – Each Set of Partners on a Bench
Partner 1 One side of bench Dips *Goal 300 Cumulative
Partner 2 10 Box Jumps other side of bench

Group 4:  The Cat Box
Partner 1 – Pullups *Goal 100 Cumulative
Partner 2 – Sprint to cones across the field / 5 Burpees / Sprint Back

Group 5:  The Kitty Box
Partner 1 Mike Tyson’s at cone *Goal 150 Cumulative
Partner 2 Bear Crawl length of Volleyball Court / Crawl Bear Back (modification: lunges)

Back to the flag for Mary.  Exile crushed us with straight leg holds, Squirtel led some version of monkey humpers on the ground (sorry…can't remember what you called the exercise), Ice-T led American Hammer, and Blackhawk capped off Mary with 30 tough Merkins.
I then had the honor of speaking to what each of the "F's" meant for me personally and how F3 has helped me grow and be a better person over the past year.  Can't thank you all enough for coming out and supporting the launch.  Keep EH'ing those around the Bridgemill Area to come out.  Whether it's the fitness, the fellowship, or the faith…there are so many men out there who needs one or more of the F's in their lives.
I then handed it over to Pie Bar where he presented The Colonel with a fine bottle of bourbon.  It's such a small token for what this man has done for our country.  Best of luck to you in the next phase of your working career.  We all know you'll continue to lead in whatever profession that you go into and appreciate your leadership within the F3 fellowship.  Congrats brother!
Pie Bar then led name-a-rama and in the prayer.  We pray for our country, for the continued growth of the brotherhood that is F3, and for some sort of "normalcy" in the near future.
Special shout out to Co-Site Leader Pie Bar, Fleetwood, Rembrandt, and Ice-T for helping to lead the work out this morning.
Enjoyed it men!  Successful launch thanks to you all for coming out and working so hard!

backblasts.title: We all hate Hartford
backblasts.body:
The call rang out late yesterday… Hartford went down and needed someone to pinch hit and take the Q for today. As you know, pinch hitters strike out more than anything else and YHC was no exception.
It was a perfect 61 degrees and YHC arrived with the increased excitement and nervousness that comes with the responsibility of leading. The Pax were counted and the number was 12. YHC made the decision that the beatdown would be spread out enough that breaking into two groups was not needed. And just like that we were on the move. A quick mosey around Freedom MS with some nice IBM related banter with Hardrive (retired IBMer) made for a pleasant start.
We circled up behind the school and after a quick disclaimer jumped right into the warm-o-rama. 15 SSH IC, 15 Weed pickers, 10 Windmills, 8 Copperhead squats, 5 Copperhead merkins. Mosey to main entrance (bottom of hill).
The Thang: As soon as instructions were given two Pax found their way to the group. Don't ever underestimate the value of an extra 90 seconds of sleep. The beatdown was simple. Modified 4 Corner Escalators. Lap one: 10 Hand release merkins at each corner. Lap two: add 20 Jump lunges. Lap three: add 30 Peter Parkers. Lap 4: 40 Flutter kicks. Early into lap two, YHC realized the folly of all those Peter Parkers and modified to a set of 30 or 3 fails, which ever comes first. Don't ask which came first. Except RugBurn and The Situation, they killed the workout and did YHC the courtesy of pretending they tried hard. CrissCross and MallCop were the first back to the flag, they had a little too much energy at the end IMHO.
GREAT to see the regulars T, Short, Twinkle, Dump, Swap and especially nice to see Snap-On back at the Den. I would like to thank OddJob for sticking close to YHC during the event and acting as beat as YHC was. Special shout out to Tackleberry. This was his second beatdown (EH'd by MallCop) and he came through like a champ.
COT: Cat Box starting this Saturday at 6:30am at Bridgemill park. Prayers for direction and guidance for 18 year old buddy of Criss Cross'. Bakery/Chop House/Puddle back at it tomorrow morning for ch 8 + 9. Check Slack for time and place.
Until next time…

Exercise

Start no run, yell every one on their six.
A scout wakes up to revile, when revile plays do 20 situps. Revile is the start of a 45 minute playlist.
20 situps in cadence

Everyone gets out of their tents and stands up to stretch.
Windmills

Side straddle hops

Frankenstein's

Mozzie to each Merritt badge, do them in any order see fit. Ask a question at the end of each one. If wrong do 10 burpees.

First aid:

Learn search and rescue. Line up and lunge across the parking lot. Then do firemen Carrie's across the parking lot with a partner, then go back at the end.
Lunge across parking

Firemen carry once with each partner.

Question: how many scoutmasters does it take to change a light bulb?
Answer: None, they make the scouts do it.

Gardening: 

Do wheel barrows then air sqauts to plant a tree.
Wheel barrows across distance with partner

30 air sqauts

Question: Girl scouts sell cookies, what do Boy scouts sell?
Answer: Popcorn

Knife safety:

After Jack knifes, explain a new scout caused a random amount of damage, do 2x a playing card to determine the damage, and do that many merkins to repair it.
30 jack knifes.

2x playing card merkins

Question: how many eagle scouts are there?
2.5 million

Geology
American hammers to mine the stone and 20 diamond merkins.
American hammers 30 double count

Diamond merkins 20

Swimming:

Everyone gets in a circle for merkins, and does the wave in merkins for 120 seconds. Then Carolina dry docks 20.
Merkins wave 120 seconds

20 Carolina dry docks

Time to cook dinner:

Food related exercises
Future me: Never came to fruition, would love suggestions to try and do a second one

Silent side straddle hops, pick and exercise each round
Air press 20
Merkins 25

Burpees 20
Pickle pointers 50

backblasts.body:
The BackBlast:
Intro:  Smurfette posted on Slack the night before asking if he could have the Q.  YHC had actually planned a beatdown, but was willing to give it up.  In the morning, Smurfette said his plan was to run us around a lot and make it up on the go, so YHC quickly stole it back.

The Thang:  DayLight Savings Time (using the letters D L S and T).
Dips, LBC's, Squats, T-Rex Merkins.  Each round consists 5 Dips, 10 LBC's, 15 Squats, and 20 T-Rex Merkins (short arm fast paced Merkins).  We did a total of 20 rounds.  No rest in between the rounds.  After every five rounds, we ran the short loop.  Starting from the alcove, along the edge of the grass, turn right at the firepit and then to the blacktop and around the back of the church and back to the alcove.  After 20 rounds, the PAX would have done a total of 100 Dips, 200 LBC's, 300 Squats, and 400 T-Rex Merkins, and run a mile.
COT:  Spock getting back to work after he and his M have had the past few weeks off with their new baby.  Smurfette's M got some advice from her chiro doc and this should help continue to offset some of the challenges she has had.

Naked Man Moleskin:  Mandals did not make it out this morning.  He expressed that he realized today he needed a day off to refresh himself.  This should be used as an example to all of us.  Sometimes our M's need an extra morning of us not disturbing their sleep, or our bodies need time to recover.

Name-o-rama, 6th man (Vespa), praises and prayers
Naked Man Moleskin:
These boys can fly here. Last time I did this routine there was no time left over. Mandals kept the party going with some awesome 6th man questions that got Vespa talking about camp at Young Life and then some very graphic Navy stories. Glad I joined the National Guard, hahahaha.
The morning ended with a lively discussion of Girl Scot cookies with the consensus being that Samoas are the fan favorite (still don't get this), but I was advised that they are only good when frozen. I'll have to add this to the list of things to try.
I have to hand it to the men at Oz. They launched with little to no marketing, struggled with numbers and a solid location in the first few months, but they are a force to be reckoned with. The BackBlast:
Intro:  In honor of President's Day, and the 45 Presidents that have been elected, each exercise consisted of a 45 second burst, with 15 seconds of active rest in between.  (All exercises except the warm-up followed this pattern).  Everything is AMRAP

Warm-o-Rama:  1 minute Merkins, 15 second active rest.  1 minute Bonnie Blairs (thanks Gecko), 15 second active rest.  1 minute Bicycles, 15 second active rest.  1 minute Box Jumps, 15 second active rest.  1 minute Flutter Kicks, 15 second active rest.
The Thang:  6 Rds of brutal, High Intensity Interval Training.
First five rounds: At your own pace
45 second Knee Taps, 15 second active rest.
45 second Burpees w/Tuck, 15 second active rest.
45 second American Hammers, 15 second active rest.
45 second X Mtn Climbers, 15 second active rest.
45 second Elbow Plank, Knee to Elbow, 15 second active rest.
45 second X Crunches L/R, 15 second active rest.
15 count in between each round.
By the end of the second round, any mumble chatter that was present, became non-existent, save a joke from Smurfette about why he was doing In and Outs during his active rest, something about it being a while and Mandals remarking about the different beatdown styles of Lucky Charms and YHC.  He remarked that Lucky kills you by running a marathon and YHC kills you in place.  What a compliment!!
Final rd: No active rest in between, double time pace.  YHC was super smoked by the end and worked extra hard to talk Smurfette from doing a post beatdown run of 5.5 from Oz to the Blacktop that YHC had agreed to before the beatdown.

COT:  Long Island has a job interview today.  Smurfette's M has gotten a diagnosis and treatment plan for her bout with Vertigo.

Naked Man Moleskin:  We all have different beliefs: how we view the world, how we lead our families, what faith system we are a part of, what political party we support, etc.  And guess what?  That is totally okay, because we are more alike than different.  We all bleed the same.  We all want to be the best we can.  We all sweat and tire and push through theses beatdowns the same.  Instead of letting what makes us different keep us from genuine relationships, let our commonalities be the building blocks that allow us to understand and respect and champion those differences we do have.

backblasts.title: Burps, discs and stones
backblasts.body:
The BackBlast:
Intro:
YHC was excited to Q at the OZ again.  It has been way too long and thankfully, it did not disappoint.

Warm-o-Rama:
SSH
MCs
MPs
The Thang:
Began with a Mosey up around the lot
Lined up on a curb, did an ascending merkin line – all PAX line up on the curb, do merkins OYO, the last PAX moves up front after 5 and continues doing merkins, then the next PAX begins counting to 5 until you get all the way through
Burpee Mile – Run as a group, dropping to do burpees on YHC's mark (15 for a few rounds, then 10 – 75 burpees total)
Grab disc for Frisbears – 2 rounds of every PAX throwing disc, PAX sprint after disc, bear crawl to it when it lands, unless someone catches it
Indian Coupon Run – grab heavy river stones, do indian run with them, raise above head on YHC's mark and down on mark – run whole lot back and forth
Burpee ROF- alternate low and high planks while each PAX takes a turn at doing 5 burpees around circle
Captain Thor's to end – 8 rounds until time
COT:
Prayers for Waffle Cone, Pruitt family

Naked Man Moleskin:
YHC was nervous that he would not show up in the right place, but thankfully LC ensured YHC did not go down to Peachtree City by sending a MapQuest link over Slack.  YHC showed up and started prepping, being instantly greeted with the Whistle Pig of the cookie world, Girl Scout cookies from Vespa.  Once our shady dealings were done, Shaggy slowly made his way out of the woods to join us after feasting on last night's kill, while the PAX debated glove usage.
We started to run and apparently some PAX (LC) were concerned YHC was going to leave them in the dust after simply running to the higher end of the parking lot. Someone started to quote no man left on their behind or something like that. All the PAX loved the merkin line, someone gave YHC a hug afterwards in gratitude.
Apparently Spielberg sold his soul to acquire the power of burpees. Don't think YHC has seen someone enjoy doing burpees as much as Spielberg, as well as doing them so flippin' fast. He kept finishing and then would just stare at you while you finished, it got uncomfortable, but YHC started to wonder if said soul exchange may be worth the burpee power as well.  Before YHC could dwell on the ramifications of that deal, we finished as Spielberg nodded knowingly.  (Thanks for the business card you gave YHC after the CoT for that soul exchange and conjuring!)
We played around with the disc afterwards, LC couldn't touch it as he has sworn an oath again all things involving discs in F3.  Mandals got fancy with a hammer throw, sliding catch, catch between the teeth, under the leg toss, catch on top of a moving car, toss while a monkey is insulting you about your credit score (YHC thinks that was real…not sure).  It was really impressive. Contrary to the League, Spielberg was unable to catch anything. Apparently his soul powers can only give him one area of strength each day. Someone tossed the disc towards the woods instead of straight (thanks for that), which allowed YHC to discover the coupons and change up the normal plan (which would have been more burpees to music). LC or someone else, (LC) made a comment that they couldn't hear the music and if only it had a strap for someone to carry it, that would be great.  YHC didn't want to get his phone wet, so… yeah… suck it, YHCs tech is delicate and needs to be cared for like an overprotective mom guiding her young son through a crowd of alcoholic clowns.
YHC is not sure, but suspected Odd Job was contemplating hitting YHC with a rock/coupon during the indian run.  YHC turned around to mention something and he had it over his head with that crazy look in his eye.  Could have just been because YHC said to hold it above your head for this stretch, but you never know with ol' Odd Job…aka the Scranton Strangler… you never know
Vespa had the best downward dog plank of the bunch, if you are just going to go for it, YHC would appreciate the PAX modeling their downward dogs after Vespa's.  Vespa also mentioned something about Black History Month and his right to do what he wants …not sure…YHC just didn't make eye contact, agreed 100% and sprinted away like Ralph Fiennes in the Grand Budapest Hotel

backblasts.body:
The BackBlast:
Intro:
It's terrible and you'll need twenty towels.
Warm-o-Rama:
10 Weally wet WPS IC
15 Flutter kicks – IC
The Thang:
Partner B.A.M.S.
Beginning underneath the left side walkway, partner 1 will run across to the other side of the courtyard and perform BAMS while partner 2 holds/amraps exercise until they return.  Flapjack.  Routine and reps were as follows: (BAMS reps increased by 5 each round)
B- Burpees (5,10,15,20)   > partner 2 BBTW (hold)
A – American Hammers (10,15,20,25) > partner 2 AST’s  (AMRAP)
M – Merkins (15, 20, 25,30) > partner 2 Mtn Climbers (AMRAP)
S – Squats (20,25,30,35) > partner 2 SSH (AMRAP)
With 12 mins left, YHC called an audible and circled up in middle of courtyard for a few rounds of mary.
COT:
Continued prayers for Sharapova and Amy; scan scheduled for later today. 
Naked Man Moleskin:
5:20 a.m. – El Naste is raging as YHC pulled into the empty FMS lot. 
5:23 a.m. – Other potential casualties arrive and YHC is met by Chops exclaiming  “This is great, let’s DO this!  This is one of those memorable mornings!”  YHC has never seen so much enthusiasm from any PAX and the sky brilliantly lighting behind him, made it even more impactful. 
5:25 a.m. – 11 PAX’s gather under the awning, eyes shifting from the storm to the site Q. and his call.  Or is it his call?   Does the site Q or QIC make the call?? Oh FTL?!?
5:26  a.m. – Hartford begins to discuss the odds of being struck by lightening, and QIC asks if those glow in the dark glasses are a conductor.    PB requests we silence this odds making chatter. Speaking of silence..
5:27 a.m. – Fleetwood arrives
5:27:02 a.m. – A final clap of thunder, did someone just hear “RESPECT!”  Storm ceases.  WHOA…
5:29:30 – Did some just hear “30 SECONDS!!”  How can Chops be this enthusiastic and not drink coffee! 
5:30 a.m. – Sky Q gives a safe workout window.  
5:34 a.m. – Rain begins to fall again, as we begin the thang.  Fortunately for YHC, one certain PAX needed a partner.   "Fleetwood!  Let's do this!"

backblasts.body:
The BackBlast:
Intro:  We did not quite finish the Elevens from YHC Q at the Blacktop on Friday, so figured there was more pain to pass out

Warm-o-Rama:  Mosey from flag to the front sidewalk on Sixes Road to the other side of the church.  15 SSH, 8 Weed Pickers, and mosey back to the flag.  Some Michael Phelps OYO while some of the PAX took YHC recommendation to get their gloves.

The Thang:  Continuing the 11s with a Coupon carry/run 40 yards in between each revolution!!
1st Rd: Started with some Marionettes, which I mistakenly called Little Mermaids on Friday's beatdown, and Knerkins (Merkins done on one's knuckles)  A total of 220 Ab exercises and 55 Knerkins.
2nd Rd:  LBCs and One Legged Burpees, which I picked up from Einstein at the Lion's Den on Thursday.  They sucked.  55 Ab exercises and 55 Merkins as part of the burpees.
3rd Rd:  In honor of the Super Bowl, we finished off with some 4 count J-Lo's and Mike Tysons.  220 Ab exercises and 55 Merkins as part of the Mike Tysons.
YHC made a mistake of asking anyone if they wanted Post Beatdown Run and Waffle Cone took me up on the offer.  Got in a 2.7 mile run.

COT:  Brownie's mother and his M's mother are both having some health challenges at this time.  Dump Truck's M is having check up on his unborn 2.0 with a specialist this morning.  Waffle Cone shared some unique struggles he is going through (specifics I'll leave for our circle this morning).  He is also beginning the search for a new job at this time.  Smurfette did not make it out this morning but his M is having some intense spells of vertigo and they are searching for answers.

Naked Man Moleskin:  I shared some of my feelings today about the flag and the Pledge of Allegiance and my thoughts towards both.  I thought about vocalizing here, but for the sake of not being taken out of context, I would encourage you to instead ask me about it.
